a: Deha kanya bahavaya. vei bat yisrael lechohen hi — lo maachil lah mishshum deulla.
Vehacheresh. i bat kohen leyisrael hi — pasel la, deha kanya betakkanta derabbanan. vei bat yisrael lechohen hi — la maachel, "kinyan kaspo" amar rachamana, vehay lav bar kinyan hu.
Uven tesha shanim vechulei. ka salka datin, beshomeret yavam leven tesha veyom echad. lemay? i lemifsal — katan name mifsal pasel, i leochole — gadol name lo maachil!

Amar abbaye: hacha beyavam ben tesha shanim veyom echad habba al yevimto askinan. demiddeorayyta kanya leh, salka datach amena: hoil umiddeorayyta kanya leh uviato bia, ema lochel, ka mashma lan asu biat ben tesha shanim veyom echad kemaamar begadol.
Amar leh rava: i hachi, sefa dekatane: safek ben tesha shanim veyom echad safek sheeno — hasheta vadday ben tesha lo maachil, safek mibbaya?!

Ella amar rava: beven tesha shanim veyom echad dehanach pesulim katane, defasli beviatan. vechidtanya: ben tesha shanim veyom echad, ger, ammoni umoavi, mitzri vaadomi, kuti, natin, chalal umamzer shebbau al kohenet leviyya veyisreelit — pesaluha.
Veha middekatane sefa: im enan reuyin lavo beyisrael — hare ellu poslim, mikkelal deresha lav bifsulim askinan! resha pesule kahal, sefa pesule chehunna.
Gufa: ben tesha shanim veyom echad, ger, ammoni umoavi, mitzri vaadomi, kuti, natin, chalal umamzer shebbau al kohenet leviyya veyisreelit — pesaluha.

Rabbi yose omer: kol shezzaro pasul — posel, kol sheen zaro pasul — eno posel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheatta nose bitto — atta nose almenato, vechol sheen atta nose bitto — i atta nose almenato.
Mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, amar kera: "uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar", kevan shennivala lefasul lah — pesalah.
Hay mibbee leh dekaamar rachamana bat kohen deminnasva lezar — la techul!
Hahi, mivveshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel" nafka. middekaamar rachamana: "veshava el bet aviha ... tochel", mikkelal demeikkara la achla.
I mehahi, hava amena: lav habba mikkelal ase — ase, ketav rachamana hay lelav. [lav] mivchol zar lo yochal kodesh" nafka.
b: Hahu mibbee leh legufeh! tere "vechol zar" ketivi.
Veakkatti mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: "vechol zar" — zarut amarti lecha, velo aninut! derabbi yose berabbi chanina min "zar" "vechol zar" nafka.

Veakkatti mibbee leh lechidtanya: keshehi chozeret — chozeret litruma veenah chozeret lechaze vashok. veamar rav chisda amar ravina bar rav shela: may kera, dichtiv: "uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel" — lo tochal bammuram min hakkodashim.
Im ken, lichtov kera: "hi bakkodashim lo tochal". may "bitrumat hakkodashim"? shamat minna tarte.
Ashkechan kohenet — leviyya veyisreelit menalan? kidamar rabbi abba amar rav — "bat" "uvat", hacha name — "bat" "uvat".
Keman — kerabbi akiva, dedaresh vavin? afillu tema rabbanan, kulleh "uvat" kera yattira hu.
Ashkechan litruma, lichhunna menalan? attu leviyya veyisreelit la lichhunna merabbenan lehu? dei litruma, benot mechal teruma ninhu?
Allema la, mashkachat la dekaachla bishvil benah.
Bishvil benah kal vachomer: uma kohenet, devikdushsha denafsha achla — pasel lah, leviyya veyisreelit, dela achla ella bishvil benah — lo kol shekken?

Vehi hannotenet: kohenet dekaddish gufa — pasel la, ha, dela kaddish gufa — la pasel la. ella lichhunna, kal vachomer miggerusha: uma gerusha shemmutteret bitruma — asura lakkehunna, zo sheasura bitruma — eno din sheppesula lakkehunna?!
Vechi mazhirin min haddin? gilluy milleta bealma hu.
Veema nivala lefasul lah — chayyayve karetot, "ki tihye" amar rachamana: hanach deit behu havaya. chayyayve karetot lav bene havaya.

I hachi, goy veeved la lifselu! hanach pasli midderabbi yishmael. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: minnayin legoy veeved shebba al bat yisrael veal kohenet uleviyya, sheppesaluha — shenneemar: "uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vegomer" —

a: Mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah, yatzu goy veeved sheen lo almenut vegerushin.
Ashkechan kohenet — leviyya veyisreelit mena lan? kidamar rabbi abba amar rav: "bat" "uvat", hacha name "bat" "uvat".
Keman — kerabbi akiva dedaresh vave? afillu tema rabbanan — kulle "uvat" kera yattira hu.
Veema: mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah, ki let leh zera — kaachla, ki it leh zera — la achla. mi sheen lo almenut vegerushin bah, af al gav deit leh zera name techol!
Im ken, rabboye leviyya veyisreelit lema li?
Ulerabbi akiva deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin, umay "ki tihye leish zar" — ki tibbael, almana ugerusha lema li?

Almana lehachemir aleha, ugerusha lehakel aleha. utzericha. dei ashmeinan almana: almana hu dechi let la zera — achla, mishshum dechazya lichhunna. aval gerusha, dela chazya lichhunna, ema af al gav delet la zera — la achla. vei ashmeinan gerusha: gerusha hu dechi it la zera — la achla, mishshum dela chazya lichhunna. aval almana, dechazya lichhunna, ema af al gav deit la zera — name techol, tzericha.
Veema nivala lefasul lah af machzir gerushato! "leish zar" amar rachamana, mi shezzar etzlah meikkara. leappoke hay, delo zar etzlah meikkara hu.
I hachi, chalal, delav zar hu meikkara, la lifsol! amar kera: "lo yechallel zaro beammav", makkish zaro lo, ma hu posel — af zaro name posel.
Veema mishsheat havaya! dumeya dechohen gadol bealmana: ma kohen gadol bealmana bevia, af hay name bevia.
Veema: ad deikka havaya uvia?! dumeya dechohen gadol bealmana: ma kohen gadol bealmana bevia lechudda, af hay name bevia lechudda.
Verabbi yose omer: kol shezzaro pasul — posel, vechol sheen zaro pasul — eno posel. may ikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi yose?
Amar rabbi yochanan: mitzri sheni vaadomi sheni ikka benayyhu.
Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana. tanna kamma savar: ma kohen gadol bealmana, shebbiato baavera ufosel — af hay name posel.

Verabbi yose savar: kechohen gadol. ma kohen gadol shezzaro pasul ufosel, af kol shezzaro pasul — posel. leappoke mitzri sheni deen zaro pasul. dichtiv: "banim asher yivvaldu lahem dor shelishi yavo lahem bikhal Adonai".
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheatta nose bitto — atta nose almenato vechulei. may ikka ben rabbi yose lerabban shimon ben gamliel?
Amar ulla: ger ammoni umoavi ikka benayyhu, ushenehem lo lemaduha ella mikkohen gadol bealmana. rabbi yose savar: ma kohen gadol bealmana shezzaro pasul ufosel, af kol shezzaro pasul — posel.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: ma kohen gadol bealmana shekkol zaro pasul ufosel, af shekkol zaro pasul ufosel. leappoke ammoni umoavi, deen kol zaro pasul. deamar mar: "ammoni", velo ammonit, "moavi" velo moavit.
Mishna haones vehamefatte vehashshote — lo poslin velo maachilin. veim enan reuyin lavo beyisrael — hare ellu poslin. ketzad? (haya) yisrael shebba al bat kohen — tochal bitruma.
b: Ibbera — lo tochal bitruma. nechtach haubbar bemeeha — tochal. haya kohen shebba al bat yisrael — lo tochal bitruma, ibbera — lo tochal. yalda — tochal. nimtza kocho shel ben gadol mishshel av.

Haeved posel mishshum bia, veeno posel mishshum zera. ketzad? bat yisrael lechohen, bat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu ben, vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha, veyalda hemennu ben — hare ze eved. hayta em aviv bat yisrael lechohen — lo tochal bitruma. bat kohen leyisrael — tochal bitruma.

Mamzer posel umaachil. ketzad? bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu bat, vehalcha habbat venisset leeved o legoy veyalda hemennu ben — hare ze mamzer. hayta em immo bat yisrael lechohen — tochal bitruma. bat kohen leyisrael — lo tochal bitruma.

Kohen gadol, peamim shehu posel. ketzad? bat kohen leyisrael veyalda hemennu bat, vehalcha habbat venisset lakkohen, veyalda hemennu ben — hare ze rauy lihyot kohen gadol omed umeshammesh al gabbe hammizbeach. maachil et immo, ufosel em immo. zot omeret: lo kivni kohen gadol, shehu posleni min hatteruma.
Gemara tenena leha detanu rabbanan: shote vekatan shennasu nashim, umetu neshotehen — peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum.
Ketzad? haya yisrael shebba al bat kohen — tochal bitruma, ibbera — lo tochal. kevan deibbera lo tochal? lechush shemma ibbera! mi la tenan: mafrishin otan shelosha chodashim, shemma meubbarot hen?
Amar rabba bar rav huna: leyuchasin chashshu, litruma lo chashshu. velitruma lo chashshu? vehatanya: "hare ze gittech shaa achat kodem lemitati" — asura leechol bitruma miyyad!
Ella amar rabba bar rav huna: benissuin chashshu, biznut lo chashshu.
Uvenissuin mi chashshu? vehatanya: bat kohen shennisset leyisrael, vamet — tovelet, veochelet bitruma learev!
Amar rav chisda: tovelet veochelet ad arbaim, dei la miabbera — ha la miabbera, vei miabbera — ad arbaim mayya bealma hi.
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, ema sefa: hukkar ubbarah bemeeha — tehe mekulekelet lemafrea. may mekulekelet — ad arbaim.

Ittemar: habba al arusato bevet chamiv — rav amar: havvalad mamzer, ushemuel amar: havvalad shetuki. amar rava: mistabbera milleteh derav dedayyma mealma, aval la dayyma mealma — batreh dideh shadenan leh.
Amar rava: mena amena la — dekatane: yalda — tochal. hechi dame? illema dedayyma mealma, yalda ammay tochal? ella lav: mineh dayyma, vela dayyma mealma.
Uma hatam, dilhay issura ulehay issura — batra dideh shadenan leh, hacha, dilhay issura ulehay hettera — lo kol shekken?!

Amar leh abbaye: leolam ema lach kol hecha dedayyma minneh af al gav dela dayyma mealma amar rav havvalad mamzer. may tama — deamrinan: middeafkara nafshah legabbe arus — afkara nafshah lealma, umatnitin shehayu shenehem chavushim bevet haasurin.

Ikka deamri: beva aleha — kulle alma la peligi devatreh dideh shadenan leh. vehachi ittemar: arusa sheibbera, rav amar: havvalad mamzer. ushemuel amar: havvalad shetuki. amar rava: mistabbera milleteh derav dela dayyma minneh vedayyma mealma,

a: Aval dayyma minneh, af al gav dedayyma mealma — batreh dideh shadenan leh.
Amar rava: mena amena la — dekatane: yalda — tochal. hechi dame? illema dedayyma minneh vela dayyma mealma — tzericha lememar detechol?! ella lav — dedayyma name mealma,
Uma hatam, dilhay issura ulehay issura — batreh dideh shadenan leh, hacha, dilhay issura ulehay hettera — lo kol shekken?!
Amar leh abbaye: leolam ema lach kol hecha dedayyma mealma, af al gav dedayyma minneh, amar rav: havvalad mamzer. umatnitin bidla dayyma kelal.
Haeved posel mishshum bia kulei. may tama — amar kera: "haishsha viladeha tihye vegomer".
Mamzer posel umaachil. tanu rabbanan: "vezera en lah", en li ella zarah, zera zarah minnayin? talmud lomar: "vezera en lah" — mikkol makom.
En li ella zera kasher, zera pasul minnayin — talmud lomar: "vezera en lah", ayyen aleha.
Veha appekteh lezera zarah! zera zarah la itzterich kera, bene vanim hare hen kevanim. ki itzterich kera, lezera pasul.

Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: keman — kerabbi akiva, deamar: yesh mamzer mechayyayve lavin? afillu tema rabbanan, begoy veeved modu, dechi ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer.
Kohen gadol, peamim shepposel. tanu rabbanan: hareni kapparat ben bitti kuza — shemmaachileni batteruma, veeni kapparat ben bitti kadda — shepposleni min hatteruma.
Hadaran alach almana
Hearel vechol hattemeim — lo yochlu bitruma. neshehen veavdehen yochlu bitruma.
Petzua dakka ucherut shofcha — hen veavdehen yochelu, uneshehen lo yochelu. veim lo yada mishshennaasa petzua dakka ucherut shofcha — hare ellu yochelu.
Vee zehu petzua dakka — kol shenniftzeu habbetzim shello, vaafillu achat mehen. ucherut shofcha — kol shennichrat haggid, veim nishtayyer meatara afillu kechut hassaara — kasher.

Gemara tanya, amar rabbi elazar: minnayin learel sheen ochel bitruma? neemar "toshav vesachir" bappesach, veneemar "toshav vesachir" batteruma. ma "toshav vesachir" haamur bappesach — arel asur bo, af "toshav vesachir" haamur batteruma — arel asur bo.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "ish ish" — lerabbot hearel.

Amar mar, rabbi eliezer omer: neemar "toshav vesachir" bappesach, veneemar "toshav vesachir" batteruma. ma "toshav vesachir" haamur bappesach — arel asur bo, af "toshav vesachir" haamur batteruma — arel asur bo.
Mufene. dei lav mufene ikka lemifrach: ma lefesach, shekken chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame. laye, afnoye mufene.
He mufene? i ditruma — mitzrach tzerichi, detanya: "toshav" ze kanuy kinyan olam, "sachir" — ze kanuy kinyan shanim.
Veyeamer "toshav" veal yeamer "sachir", vaani omer: kanuy kinyan olam eno ochel — kanuy kinyan shanim lo kol shekken!
Illu ken, hayiti omer "toshav" — ze kanuy kinyan shanim, aval kanuy kinyan olam — ochel, ba sachir velimmed al toshav, sheaf al pi shekkanuy kinyan olam — en ochel.

Ella defesach mufene. hay "toshav vesachir" dichtav rachamana befesach may nihu? i nema toshav vesachir mammash, mishshum dehave leh toshav vesachir ippetar leh mippesach?! veha kayyma lan gabbe teruma dela achel!
b: Alma la kane leh rabbeh. hacha name la kane leh rabbeh, ella leafnoye.
Veakkatti mufene mitztzad echad hu, veshaminan leh lerabbi elazar deamar: mufene mitztzad echad, lemedin umeshivin?
Kevan dilgufeh la tzerich — shedi chad allamed ushedi chad ammelammed, vehave leh gezera shava mufena mishshene tzedadin.
I: ma pesach onen asur bo — af teruma onen asur bah.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina, amar kera: ("zar") "vechol zar", zarut amarti lecha, velo aninut. ema: velo arelut! ha ketiv "toshav vesachir".

Uma raita? mistabbera arelut hava leh lerabboye, shekken (maasim. kerutim. bidvar. haeved.) mechussar maase, umaase begufo, veanush karet, veyeshno lifne haddibbur, umilat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet!
Adderabba: aninut hava leh lerabboye, shekken yeshnah bechol shaa, venoheget baanashim venashim, veen beyado letakken et atzmo! hanach nefishan.
Rava amar: bela hanach nefishan name la matzet amrat. shavkinan arelut dichtiv begufeh defesach, veyalfinan aninut mippesach?! defesach gufeh mimmaaser gamrinan.
I: ma pesach milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet, af teruma milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet!
Amar kera: "umalta oto az yochal bo". milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet bo milleechol befesach, veen milat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet bitruma.
I hachi, ema: "kol arel lo yochal bo", bo eno ochel, aval ochel hu bitruma! ha ketiv "toshav vesachir"!
Uma raita? mistabbera arelut degufeh hava leh lerabboye, shekken maase begufo, veanush karet. adderabba: milat zecharav vaavadav hava leh lerabboye, shekken yeshnah bechol shaa!
Hanach nefishan. veibbaet ema: bela [hanach] nefishan name la matzet amrat. mi ikka midde daarelut degufeh la meakkeva beh, arelut deacharine meakkeva beh?!
Hasheta deamrat: "bo" lidrasha hu daata, "kol ben nechar lo yochal bo" — lema li? bo

a: Meshummadut poselet, veen meshummadut poselet bemaaser.
"Kol arel lo yochal bo" lema li? bo eno ochel, aval ochel hu bematztza umaror.

Veitzterich lemichtav "arel", veitzterich lemichtav "kol ben nechar". dei ketav rachamana "arel", mishshum dimis. aval ben nechar, dela meis — ema la. vei ketav rachamana "kol ben nechar", mishshum deen libbo lashshamayim, aval arel, delibbo lashshamayim — ema la, tzericha.
"Mimmennu" "mimmennu". lema li? lechidrabba amar rabbi yitzchak.

Amar mar, rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "ish ish", lerabbot et hearel. veema: lerabbot et haonen? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, amar kera: "vechol zar" — zarut amarti lecha, velo aninut.
Ema: velo arelut? ha ketiv "ish ish".
Uma raita? mistabbera arelut hava leh lerabboye, shekken: maasim, kerutim, bidvar, haeved. mechussar maase, umaase begufo, veanush karet, veyeshno lifne haddibbur, umilat zecharav vaavadav meakkevet.
Adderabba: aninut hava leh lerabboye, shekken: yeshnah bechol shaa, venoheget baanashim venashim, veen beyado letakken atzmo!
Hanach nefishan. rava amar: bela hanach nefishan name la matzet amrat. amar kera "ish ish", ezehu davar sheyyeshno baish veeno baishsha — have omer ze arelut.
Verabbi akiva, hay "toshav vesachir" may aved leh? amar rav shemaya: leetoye arvi mahul vegivoni mahul.

Vehane mulin ninhu? veha tenan: "kuvnnam sheani nehene laarelim" — muttar bearle yisrael, veasur bemule ummot haolam. "kuvnnam sheani nehene lemulin" — muttar bemule ummot haolam, veasur bearle yisrael!
Ella, leetoye ger shemmal velo taval, vekatan shennolad keshehu mahul. vekasavar: tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit.
Verabbi eliezer letameh, deamar: ger shemmal velo taval — ger mealleya hu, vekasavar: katan keshennolad mahul — en tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit.
Verabbi eliezer, hay "ish ish" may aved leh? dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.
Bae rav chama bar ukeva: katan arel mahu lesucho beshemen shel teruma? arelut shello bizmannah meakkeva, o la meakkeva?!
Amar rabbi zera, ta shema: en li ella milat zecharav bishat asiyya, vaavadav bishat achila. minnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze, veet haamur shel ze baze — talmud lomar: "az" "az" ligzera shava.
Bishlama avadav, mashkachat la deitanhu bishat achila veletanhu bishat asiyya, kegon dezavninhu bene bene.
Ella zecharav, deitanhu bishat achila veletanhu bishat asiyya hechi mashkachat la — lav deityelud ben asiyya laachila? shema minna: arelut shello bizmannah havya arelut!
Amar rava: vetisbera? "himmol lo chol zachar" amar rachamana, "veaz yikrav laasoto". vehay lav bar mehila hu. ella, hacha bemay askinan — kegon shechalatzattu chamma.
Venittevv leh kol shiva. deamar shemuel: chalatzattu chamma — notnin lo kol shiva! deyahavinan leh kol shiva. venimhaleh mitztzafra! baenan
b: Meet leet.
Vehatane ludaa: yom haveraato keyom hivvaldo. may lav: ma yom hivvaldo la baenan meet leet, af yom haveraato la baenan meet leet?
La, adif yom haveraato miyyom hivvaldo. deillu yom hivvaldo la baenan meet leet, veillu yom haveraato baenan meet leet.
Rav pappa amar: kegon dechaev leh eneh leyanoka veittefach bene uvene.
Rava amar: kegon shehayu aviv veimmo chavushin bevet haasurin.
Rav kahana bereh derav nechemya amar: kegon tumetum shennikra, venimtza zachar bene uvene.
Rav sherevya amar: kegon shehotzi rosho chutz lapperozdor.
Umi chaye? vehatanya: kevan sheyyatza laavir haolam, niftach hassatum venistam happatuach. sheilmale ken, en yachol lichyot afillu shaa achat!

Hacha bemay askinan, kegon dezanteh ishshata. ishshata deman? ilema ishshata dideh, i hachi kol shiva bae? ella dezanteh ishshata deimmeh. veibbaet ema: hane mille hecha dela meavve, aval hecha dimavve, michyay chaye.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa: arel mekabbel hazzaa, shekken matzinu baavotenu shekkibbelu hazzaa keshehen arelim, shenneemar: "vehaam alu min hayyarden beasor lachodesh harishon".
Baasara la mehili, mishshum chulesha deorcha. hazzaa emat aved lehu?! lav keshehen arelim?
Vedilma la avud pesach kelal? la salka datach, dichtiv: "vayyaasu et happesach".
Matkef la mar zutera: vedilma pesach habba betumea haya? amar leh rav ashe, tanya behedya: malu, vetavlu, veasu pischehen betohora.
Amar rabba bar yitzchak amar rav: lo nittena periat mila leavraham avinu, shenneemar: "baet hahi amar Adonai el yehoshua ase lecha charvot tzurim vegomer".
Vedilma hanach dela mehul, dichtiv: "ki mulim hayu kol haam hayyotzim vechol haam hayyillodim vegomer".
Im ken, may "shuv"? ella lav lifria. umay "shenit" —
Leakkoshe sof mila litchillat mila: ma techillat mila meakkevet — af sof mila meakkevin bo. ditnan: ellu hen tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila — basar hachofe et [rov] haatara, veen ochel bitruma.
Amar ravina, veittema rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: basar hachofe et rov govhah shel atara.
Uvammidbar may tama la mehul? ibbaet ema mishshum chulesha deorcha,

a: Veibbaet ema: mishshum dela neshiv lehu ruach tzefonit. detanya: kol otan arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar lo nashva lahem ruach tzefonit.
May tama? ibbaet ema mishshum dinzufim havu, vei baet ema dela nibbaddur anne chavod.
Amar rav pappa: hilkach yoma deeva veyoma deshuta — la mahalinan beh, vela mesochrinan beh. vehaiddana dedashu ba rabbim, "shomer petaim Adonai".

Tanu rabbanan: kol otan arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar, lo haya yom shello nashva bo ruach tzefonit bachatzi hallayla, shenneemar: "vayhi bachatzi hallayla vaAdonai hikka chol bechor vegomer" may talmuda? ha ka mashma lan deet retzon milleta hi.
Amar rav huna: devar tora, mashuch — ochel bitruma, umiddivrehem gazru alav, mippene shennire kearel.
Metivi: mashuch tzarich sheyyamul! midderabbanan. udekaare la, may kaare la? ha "tzarich" katane!

Katae besefa, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yimmol, mippene shessakkana hi lo. amru lo: vahalo harebe malu bime ben kozeva veholidu banim uvanot, shenneemar: "himmol yimmol", afillu mea peamim, veomer: "et beriti hefar" — lerabbot et hammashuch.
May "veomer"? vechi tema: hay "himmol yimmol" lerabbot tzitzin hameakkevim et hammila — "ta shema: "et beriti hefar", lerabbot et hammashuch.
Hu savar: middeka nasev la talmuda (kera) — deorayyta hi. vela hi: midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.

Metivi: tumetum — en ochel bitruma, nashav vaavadav — ochlin. mashuch, venolad keshehu mahul — hare ellu ochlim. anderoginos — ochel bitruma, veen ochel bekadashim. tumetum — eno ochel lo bitruma velo bekadashim.
Katane mihat: mashuch, venolad keshehu mahul — hare ellu ochlin, teyuveta derav huna! teyuveta.
Amar mar: tumetum — eno ochel bitruma, nashav vaavadav — ochlim. nashav letumetum mena leh? illema dekaddesh, detanya: tumetum shekkiddesh — kiddushav kiddushin, nitkaddesh — kiddushav kiddushin,
Emar deamar lechumera, lekulla mi amrinan? sefek ishsha hu, veen ishsha mekaddeshet ishsha?
Amar abbaye: keshebbetzav nikkarot mibbachutz.
Rava amar: may "nashav" — immo. immo, peshita! mahu detema: molid — maachil, sheen molid — eno maachil, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: tumetum — eno ochel lo bitruma velo bekadashim. bishlama leabbaye, tena resha arel vadday, vekatane sefa sefek arel.
Ella lerava, tumetum desefa lema li? may tumetum — arel.
Hasheta sefek arel la achel — vadday arel achel?! ma taam kaamar: ma taam tumetum eno ochel bitruma? mippene shessefek arel hu, vearel eno ochel lo bitruma velo bekadashim.

Lema ketannae: mashuch (venolad keshehu mahul), veger shennitgayyer keshehu mahul, vekatan sheavar zemanno, ushear kol hannimmolim, leetoye mi sheyyesh lo shete aralot — enan nimmolin ella bayyom. rabbi elazar bar shimon omer: bizmanno —
b: En nimmolin ella beyom, shello bizmanno — nimmolin beyom uvallayla. may lav, beha kamippalgi: demar savar mashuch deorayyta, umar savar mashuch derabbanan.
Vetisbera? katan sheavar zemanno mi ikka leman deamar derabbanan?
Ella, dechulle alma: mashuch — derabbanan, vekatan sheavar zemanno — deorayyta. vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar darshinan "uvayyom", umar savar la darshinan "uvayyom".
Ki ha deyatev rabbi yochanan vekadaresh: notar, bizmanno — eno nisraf ella bayyom, shello bizmanno — nisraf ben bayyom ben ballayla.
Veetiveh rabbi elazar lerabbi yochanan: en li ella nimmol lishmini sheen nimmol ella bayyom, minnayin lerabbot letisha, laasara, leachad asar lishnem asar (minnayin)? talmud lomar: "uvayyom".
Vaafillu leman dela daresh vav, vav vehe daresh. ishtik.

Batar dinfak, amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: raiti leven pedat sheyyoshev vedoresh kemoshe mippi haggevura. amar leh resh lakish: dideh hi? matnita hi. hecha tena leh? betorat kohanim. nefak, tanyay bitlata yome, vesavra bitlata yarche.
Amar rabbi elazar: arel shehizza — hazzaato keshera. mide dehave attevul yom, sheaf al pi sheasur bitruma, kasher bappara.

Ma litvul yom — shekken muttar bemaaser! attu anan laachila kaamrinan, anan lingia kaamrinan: uma tevul yom sheasur bingia ditruma — muttar bappara, arel shemmuttar bingia — eno din shemmuttar bappara?!
Tanya name hachi: arel shehizza — hazzaato keshera. umaase haya vehichshiru chachamim hazzaato.

Metivi: tumetum shekkiddesh — kiddusho pasul, mippene shehu sefek arel, vearel pasul lekaddesh. veanderoginos shekkiddesh — kiddusho kasher. rabbi yehuda omer: af anderoginos shekkiddesh — kiddushav pesulim, mippene shessefek ishsha [hu], veishsha pesula millekaddesh. katane miha: arel usefek arel pasul millekaddesh!
Amar rav yosef: hay tanna — tanna deve rabbi akiva hu, dimrabbe leh learel ketame. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: "ish ish", lerabbot hearel.
Amar rava: hava yatevna kammeh derav yosef, vekashya li: la lishtemit tanna velitne hearel vehattame, velema rabbi akiva hi.
Vela? veha katane: hearel vehattame peturim min hariyyay! hatam mishshum dimis.
Veazdu letamayyhu. detanya: hakkol kesherim lekaddesh — chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, rabbi yehuda machshir bakkatan ufosel beishsha uveanderoginos.
May tama derabbanan — dichtiv: "velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat", hanach defasli baasifa — pesulin bekiddush, hanach dichsherin baasifa — kesherim bekiddush.
Verabbi yehuda amar lach: im ken, nema kera "velakach", may "velakchu"? daafillu hanach difsulin hatam, kesherim hacha.
I hachi, ishsha name! "venatan" velo "venatna". verabbanan — i ketiv: "velakach" "venatan", hava amena shakel chad veyahev chad, ketav rachamana "velakchu".
Vei ketav rachamana "velakchu" "venatnu", hava amena deshakli tere veyahavi tere, ketav rachamana "velakchu" "venatan" — daafillu shakli tere veyahev chad.

a: "Vehizza hattahor al hattame", "tahor" — mikkelal shehu tame, limmed al tevul yom shekkasher bappara.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: arel mahu bammaaser? ki hechi deyalef pesach mimmaaser leinyan aninut, yalef name maaser mippesach leinyan arelut,
O dilma: chamur mikkal yalef, kal mechamur la yalef.
Amar lehu, tenetuha: hatteruma vehabbikkurim chayyayvim alehen mita vachomesh, vaasurin lezarim,
Vehen nichse chohen, veolin beechad umea, uteunin rechitzat yadayim veheerev shemesh. hare ellu batteruma uvabbikkurim, ma sheen ken bammaaser.
Veim ita — nitne: arel asur bahen, ma sheen ken bammaaser!
Tena veshayyayr. umay shayyayr dehay shayyayr?

Shayyayr deka tane sefa: yesh bammaaser uvabbikkurim ma sheen ken batteruma, shehammaaser vehabbikkurim teunin havaat makom, uteunin vidduy, vaasurin leonen, verabbi shimon mattir. vechayyayvin beviur, verabbi shimon poter.
Veillu asur levaer mehen betumea,
b: Veochlan betumeat atzman loke, ma sheen ken batteruma — la katane. alma tane veshayyayr.

Vaasurin leonen, verabbi shimon mattir. mena lehu — dichtiv: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha vegomer uterumat yadecha", veamar mar: "terumat yadecha" — ellu bikkurim, veittakkash bikkurim lemaaser: ma maaser asur leonen — af bikkurim asur leonen.
Verabbi shimon: teruma kerinhu rachamana, ma teruma mutteret leonen — af bikkurim muttarim leonen.
Vechayyayvin beviur, verabbi shimon poter. mar makkesh umar la makkesh.
Veasur levaer mehen betumea, veochlan betumeat atzman loke, menalan — detanya, rabbi shimon omer: "lo viarti mimmennu betame", ben sheani tame vehu tahor, ben sheani tahor vehu tame.
Vehecha muzehar al achilato eni yodea. tumeat hagguf behedya ketiv beh: "nefesh asher tigga bo vetama ad haarev velo yochal min hakkodashim ki im rachatz besaro bammayim"!

Hachi kamibbaya leh: tumeat atzmo minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha", ulehallan hu omer "bisharecha tochlennu hattame vehattahor yachdav katztzevi vechaayyal", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: afillu tame vetahor ochlin al shulechan echad bikara achat veenan choshshin, vekaamar rachamana: hahu daamari lach hatam "bisharecha tochlennu" — hacha la techol.
Ma sheen ken batteruma. mena lan? amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "lo viarti mimmennu betame" — mimmennu i atta mavir, aval atta mavir shemen shel teruma shennitma.
Veema: mimmennu i atta mavir, aval atta mavir shemen shel kodesh shennitma! lav kal vachomer hu? uma maaser hakkal amra tora "lo viarti mimmennu betame" — kodesh chamur lo kol shekken?!
I hachi, teruma name kal vachomer hu! ha ketiv "mimmennu"!
Uma raita? mistabbera kodesh la memaetna shekken 380:
Piggul, notar, korban, meila, karet, veasur leonen.
Adderabba, teruma la memaetna shekken 135: mita vachomesh, veen lah pidyon, vaasura lezarim!
Hanach nefishan. veibbaet ema: karet adifa.
Veochlan betumeat atzman loke, ma sheen ken batteruma. milka hu dela lake, ha issura ikka — menalan? amar kera: "bisharecha tochlennu" — laze velo leacher. velav habba mikkelal ase — ase.
Amar rav ashe: meresha name shamat minna ditna veshayyayr — middela katane

a: Venohagin bishar shene shavua, veen lahem pidyon. ma sheen ken bammaaser. shema minna.
Ta shema: nishtayyeyru bo tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila — hare ze eno ochel lo batteruma, velo bappesach, velo bakkodashim, velo bammaaser. may lav masar dagan, la — masar behema.
Masar behema hayeynu kadashim? velitamaych, mi la tenan pesach vekatane kadashim!
Bishlama pesach vekadashim tzerichi, dei tena pesach — mishshum daarelut befesach ketiva, aval kadashim — ema la. vei tena kadashim, hava amena: may kadashim — pesach. ella masar behema lema li?
Ella maaser rishon, verabbi meir hi, deamar: maaser rishon asur lezarim.
Ta shema, middetane rabbi chiyyay bar rav middifti: arel asur bishte maasrot. may lav: echad masar dagan veechad masar behema! hacha name, maaser rishon verabbi meir.

Ta shema: onen — asur bammaaser, umuttar batteruma uvappara. tevul yom — asur bitruma, umuttar bappara uvammaaser. mechussar kippurim — asur bappara, umuttar batteruma uvammaaser. veim ita — nitne: arel asur batteruma, umuttar bappara uvammaaser!
Hay tanna — deve rabbi akiva hi, dimrabbe leh learel ketame. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: "ish ish" — lerabbot et hearel.
Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi akiva tanna d(rabbi) yosef habbavli hi. detanya: serefat onen umechussar kippurim — keshera. (rabbi) yosef habbavli omer: onen — keshera, mechussar kippurim — pesula.

Veaf rabbi yitzchak savar arel asur bemaaser, deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin learel sheasur bammaaser — neemar "mimmennu" bammaaser, veneemar "mimmennu" bappesach. ma "mimmennu" haamur bappesach — arel asur bo, af "mimmennu" haamur bammaaser — arel asur bo.
Mufene. dei la mufene, ikka lemifrach: ma lefesach, shekken chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame. laye afnoye mufene.
May mufene? amar rava amar rabbi yitzchak: telata "mimmennu" ketivi befesach: chad legufeh, vechad ligzera shava, vechad —

Leman deamar: ba hakkatuv litten lecha ase achar lo taase — ayyeyde dichtiv "notar", ketiv name "mimmennu". uleman deamar litten lo boker sheni lisrefato — ayyeyde dichtiv "ad boker", ketiv name "mimmennu".
Telata "mimmennu" ketivi bemaaser: chad legufeh, vechad lidrabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan, vechad lidresh lakish.

Deamar resh lakish amar rabbi simay: minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma shemmuttar lesucho — shenneemar: "velo natatti mimmennu lemet". lemet hu delo natatti, ha lechay duvmya demet — natatti. ezehu davar sheshshave bachayyim uvammetim? heve omer zo sicha.

Matkef la mar zutera: veema likkach lo aron vetachrichim? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: "mimmennu" — miggufo. rav ashe amar: "la natatti" duvmya delo achalti": ma lehallan miggufo — af kan miggufo.
Veakkatti mufene mitztzad echad hu. hanicha leman deamar lemedin veen meshivin. ella leman deamar lemedin umeshivin, may ikka lememar?

Hach derabbi avahu — midderav nachman amar rabba bar avu nafka. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: may dichtiv: "vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay" — bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber: achat teruma tehora, veachat teruma temea. veamar rachamana: "lecha" — shellecha tehe, lehassaka tachat tavshilcha.
Vechol hattemeim kulei. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael, amar kera: "ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav vegomer". e zehu davar sheshshave
b: Bezaro shel aharon — heve omer zo teruma. veema bechaze vashok? enah bechozeret.
Teruma name, enah bachalala! chalala lav zaro deaharon hi.
Umimmay dehay "ad asher yithar", ad deikka heerev shemesh, ema: ad demayyte kappara?

La salka datach, detana deve rabbi yishmael: bezav baal shete reiyyot uvimtzora musegar hakkatuv medabber, dumeya ditme nefesh", ma "teme nefesh" delav bar kappara hu — hane name delav bene kappara ninhu.
Veema, hane mille delav bar kappara, aval devar kappara, ad demayyte kappara?!
Vetu, ha ditnan: taval veala — ochel bammaaser, heeriv shimsho — ochel batteruma, hevi kappara — ochel bakkodashim, mena lan?

Amar rava amar rav chisda: telata kerae ketivi. ketiv: "velo yochal min hakkodashim ki im rachatz besaro bammayim", ha rachatz — tahor. uchetiv: "uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim". uchetiv: "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera". ha ketzad? kan lemaaser, kan litruma, kan lekadashim.
Veefoch ana? mistabbera teruma adifa, shekken 135.
Adderabba: meeser adifa, shekken hadas tav?
Afillu hachi, mita adifa.
Rava amar: bela mita adifa, name la matzet amrat, amar kera: "nefesh", ezehu davar sheshshave bechol nefesh? heve omer ze maaser.
Veakkatti, hane mille hecha delav bar kappara, aval hecha devar kappara — ad demayyte kappara!
Amar abbaye: tere kerae ketivi. beyoledet ketiv: "ad melot yeme tohorah", kevan shemmalu yameha — tahera. uchetiv: "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera". ha ketzad? kan litruma, kan lekodashim.
Veefoch ana! mistabbera kodesh chamur, shekken 380.
Adderabba teruma chamura, shekken 135? hanach nefishan!

Rava amar: bela hanach nefishan la matzet amrat, amar kera: "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera", mikkelal shehi temea. vei salka datach bekadashim, ikkeri kan: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel". ella shema minna bitruma.

Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: umi matzet amrat teruma ketiva hacha? vehatanya: "dabber el bene yisrael", en li ella bene yisrael — giyyoret veshifcha meshuchereret minnayin? talmud lomar: "ishsha". vei salka datach bitruma, giyyoret veshifcha benot mechal teruma ninhu?
Amar rava: vela?

a: Vehachtiv: "bechol kodesh lo tigga" — lerabbot [et] hatteruma! ella, kera mille mille ka chashev.
Utelata kerae bitruma lema li? tzerichi, dei mead asher yithar", la hava yadana bemay — ketav rachamana: "uva hashshemesh vetaher".
Vei ketav rachamana "uva hashshemesh", hane mille delav bar kappara, aval devar kappara ema ad demayyte kappara — ketav rachamana: "ad melot".
Vei ketav rachamana "ad melot" — hava amena afillu belo tevila — ketav rachamana: "ad asher yithar".

Ulehach tanna diflig aleh detanna deve rabbi yishmael, deamar bezav baal shalosh reiyyot uvimtzora muchelat hakkatuv medabber, vehay "ad asher yithar" — ad demayyte kappara, tere kerae bekadashim lema li?
Tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana beyoledet — mishshum dimrubba tumeatah, aval bezav — ema la. vei ketav rachamana bezav — delo huttar mikkelalo, aval yoledet — ema la, tzericha.
"Bammayim yuva vetame ad haerev" lema li? amar rabbi zera: lingia.
Detanya: "vetame" — yachol lakkol, talmud lomar: "vetaher". i "vetaher" — yachol lakkol, talmud lomar: "vetame". ha ketzad? kan lemaaser, kan litruma.
Veefoch ana! mistabbera ki hechi dachamira achila ditruma meachila demaaser — hachi name chamira negia ditruma minnegia demaaser.
Veibbaet ema negia ditruma mehacha nafka: "bechol kodesh lo tigga" — azhara laochel. o eno ella lannogea?

Talmud lomar: "bechol kodesh lo tigga veel hammikdash lo tavo", makkish kodesh lammikdash: ma mikdash — davar sheyyesh bo netilat neshama, af kodesh — davar sheyyesh bo netilat neshama. uvingia, netilat neshama lekka,
Vehay deappekeh bilshon negia, hachi kaamar: negia kaachila.
Petzua dakka vechulei. man tanna mishtammeret levia pesula, deorayyta achla? amar rabbi elazar: bemachloket shenuya, verabbi elazar verabbi shimon hi.
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi meir, shane hacha shekkevar achla.
Verabbi elazar, shekkevar achla la amrinan. dei la tema hachi, bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet balah — tochal, shekkevar achla.
Verabbi yochanan: hatam — paka kinyayneh, hacha — la paka kinyayneh.

Ezehu petzua. tanu rabbanan: ezehu petzua dakka — kol shenniftzeu betzim shello, vaafillu achat mehen, vaafillu nikkevu, vaafillu nimmoku, vaafillu chasru. amar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka: shamati mippi chachamim bakkerem beyavne: kol sheen lo ella betza achat — eno ella seris chamma, vechasher.
Seris chamma salka datach?! ella: hare hu kisris chamma, vechasher.
Venikkav la moled? veha hahu gavra dislek ledikla
b: Vecharzeh silva bevetzim, unefak minneh kechut demugela, veoled! ha shelach shemuel lekammeh derav vaamar leh: tze vechazar al banav meen hem.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: petzua dakka bide shamayim kasher. amar rava: hayeynu dekarenan "petzua", vela karenan "happatzua".
Bematnita tana, neemar: "lo yavo fetzua", veneemar "lo yavo mamzer". ma lehallan bide adam, af kan bide adam.

Amar rava: patzua — bechullan, dach — bechullan, karut — bechullan. patzua bechullan — ben shenniftza haggid, ben shenniftzeu betzim, ben shenniftzeu chute betzim. dach bechullan — ben shenniddach haggid, ben shenniddakku betzim, ben shenniddakku chute vetzim. kerut [bechullan] — ben shennichrat haggid, ben shennichretu betzim, ben shennichretu chute vetzim.
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: mimmay dehay petzua dakka beoto makom? ema merosho? amar leh: middela mena beh dorot, shema minna beoto makom.
Vedilma hay dela mana bo dorot, deihu hu deasur, bereh uvar bereh kasher?
Dumeya dichrut shofcha: ma kerut shofcha — beoto makom, af hay name beoto makom.
Ucherut shofcha gufeh mimmay divoto makom hu? ema missifteh! "shofcha" ketiv — bemakom sheshshofech.
Veema mechotmo? mi ketiv "bishfoch"?! "kerut shofcha" ketiv — mi sheal yede kerita shofech, shello al yede kerita eno shofech ella mekalleach. leappoke hay, deidde veidde shofech hu.
Bematnita tana, neemar: "lo yavo fetzua dakka", veneemar: "lo yavo mamzer". ma lehallan beoto makom, af kan beoto makom.
Nikkav lematta meatara, shekkenegdo lemala meatara, savar rabbi chiyyay bar abba leachshore. amar leh rabbi assi: hachi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: atara kol shehi meakkevet.
Veim nishtayyer meatara kulei. yatev ravina vekamibbaya leh: melo hachut sheamru, al pene kullah o al pene rubbah? amar leh rava tosfaa leravina: melo hachut — al pene rubbah, uchelappe resha.
Amar rav huna: kekulemos — keshera, kemarzev — pesula. hay — shalet ba avvera, vehay — la shalet ba avvera. verav chisda amar: kemarzev keshera, kekulemos pesula! hay — gared, vehay — la gared.
Amar rava: kevoteh derav huna mistabbera. hay la shalet ba avvera vehay shalet ba avvera, i mishshum geriduta — midde dehave abbarza dechavita.

Amar leh ravina lemarimar, hachi amar mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa: hilcheta, ben kekulemos ben kemarzev — keshera. mihu, mibbaya leh: lematta meatara, o lemala? peshita dilmala meatara, dei salka datach lematta meatara — afillu nichrat haggid name. veravina leshabboshe lemarimar hu devae.

Hahu ovada dahava bemata machseya, shappeyeh mar bar rav ashe kekulemos veachshereh. hahu ovada dahava befumebdita, istetim guveta deshichvat zera, veappek bimkom ketannim. sevar rav bivi bar abbaye leachshore. amar rav pappi: mishshum deattu

a: Mimmulae, amritu mille muleyata? bimkomah — mevashshela, shello bimkomah — la mevashshela.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: nikkav venistam, kol sheillu nikre venikra — pesul. vei lav — kasher. have be rava: hecha? illema lematta meatara — afillu nichrat name, ella baatara atzmah. ittemar name, amar rav mari bar mar amar mar ukeva amar shemuel: nikkav baatara atzmah venistam, kol sheillu nikre venikra pasul, vei lav — kasher.
Shelach leh rava bereh derabba lerav yosef: yelammedenu rabbenu, hechi avdinan? amar leh: mayytinan nahama chammima disare, umannechinan leh abbe fokre, umikkere, vechazenan leh.
Amar abbaye: attu kulle alma yaakov avinu havay, dichtiv beh "kochi vereshit oni", shello raa keri miyyamav!
Ella, amar abbaye: meabberinan kammeh bigde tzivonin. amar rava: attu kulle alma barzillay haggiladi hu?! ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.

Tanu rabbanan: nikkav — pasul, mippene shehu shotet. nistam — kasher, mippene shehu molid. vezehu pesul shechozer lehechshero. "zehu" lemaote may? lemaote kerum sheala mechamat makka barea, deeno kerum.

Shelach leh rav idi bar avin leabbaye: hechi avdinan? mayytinan searta umesartinan leh, umayytinan tarba veshayyfinan, umayytinan shumeshana gamla umenakketinan leh, ufaskinan leh leresheh. vedavka searta, aval parzela — mizraf zaref. vehane mille katan, aval gadol — ikkappole mikkappal.

Amar rabba bar rav huna: hammetil mayim mishshete mekomot, pasul. amar rava: let hilcheta la kivra vela keabba, bera — ha daamaran. abba — deamar rav huna: nashim hamesollot zo bazo, pesulot lakkehunna.
Vaafillu lerabbi elazar, deamar: panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut asaah zona — hane mille ish, aval ishsha peritzuta bealma.
Mishna petzua dakka ucherut shofcha muttarin begiyyoret umeshuchereret, veenan asurin ella millavo bakkahal, shenneemar: "lo yavo fetzua dakka ucherut shofcha bikhal Adonai".
Gemara beo minneh merav sheshet: petzua dakka kohen mahu, begiyyoret umeshuchereret? bikdusheteh kae vaasir, o dilma lav bikdusheteh kae ushere?
Amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetuha: petzua dakka yisrael — muttar bintina. vei salka datach bikdusheteh kae, ikri kan "lo titchatten bam".

Amar rava: attu hatam mishshum kedushsha velav kedushsha hu? dilma moled ben, veazel palach laavoda zara. vehane mille — begoyutan, ki miggayyri (beyisrael) [mishra] sheru, verabbanan hu digzaru behu. vechi gezaru behu rabbanan — behanach divne olode, aval hay delav bar olode — la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Ella meatta, mamzer, devar olode, hachi name daasir? veha tenan: mamzerim unetinim muttarim lavo ze baze! ella: ki gezur rabbanan — bichsherim. bifsulim la gezur rabbanan.
Hadar amar rava: lav milleta hi, begoyutan — let lehu chatnut, nitgayyeyru — it lehu chatnut.
Metiv rav yosef: "vayyitchatten shelomo et bat paro melech mitzrayim"! gayyyore gayyeyra. veha lo kibbelu gerim lo bime david velo bime shelomo! midde hu tama — ella leshulechan melachim,
b: Ha la tzericha leh.
[Vetippok leh] deha mitzrit rishona hi! vechi tema: hanach azli lealma vehane acharine ninhu,

Veha tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: minyamin ger mitzri haya li chaver mittalmide rabbi akiva, amar: ani mitzri rishon, venasati mitzrit rishona. assi livni mitzrit sheniyya kede sheyyehe ben beni rauy lavo bakkahal!

Amar rav pappa: anan mishshelomo leku venotev? shelomo la nesev midde, dichtiv beh: "min haggoyim asher amar Adonai el bene yisrael lo tavou bahem vehem lo yavou vachem achen yattu et levavchem achare elohehem, bahem davak shelomo leahava". ella kashya "vayyitchatten"!
Mittoch ahava yetera sheahevah, maale alav hakkatuv keillu nitchatten bah.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, veha anan tenan: petzua dakka ucherut shofcha muttarim begiyyoret umeshuchereret. ha bintina — asiri!
Amar leh: velitamaych, ema sefa: veenan asurin ella millavo bakkahal. ha bintina sharu! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Mishna ammoni umoavi — asurim, veissuran issur olam. aval nekevotehem — muttarot miyyad.

Mitzri vaadomi enam asurim ella ad shelosha dorot, echad zecharim veechad nekevot. rabbi shimon mattir et hannekevot miyyad. amar rabbi shimon, kal vachomer haddevarim: uma im bemakom sheasar et hazzecharim issur olam — hittir et hannekevot miyyad, makom shella asar et hazzecharim ella ad shelosha dorot — eno din shennattir et hannekevot miyyad?
Amru lo: im halacha — nekabbel, veim laddin — yesh teshuva. amar lahem: lo ki, halacha ani omer.

Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vechirot shaul et david yotze likrat happelishti amar el avner sar hatztzava ben mi ze hannaar avner vayyomer avner che nafshecha hammelech im yadati". vela yeda leh? vehachtiv: "vayyeehavehu meod vayhi lo nose kelim"! ella aavu ka meshael.
Veaviv la yeda leh? vehachtiv: "vehaish bime shaul zaken ba vaanashim", veamar rav, veittema rabbi abba: ze yishay avi david, shennichnas beuchelusa veyatza beuchelusa!
Hachi kaamar shaul: i mipperetz ate, i mizzerach ate? i mipperetz ate — malka have, shehammelech poretz laasot derech veen memachin beyado. i mizzerach ate — chashiva bealma have.

May tama amar leh shael aleh, dichtiv: "vayyalbesh shaul et david maddav", kemiddato. uchetiv beh beshaul: "mishshichmo vamala gavoah mikkol haam". amar leh doeg haadomi: ad sheatta meshael alav im hagun hu lammalchut im lav, sheal alav im rauy lavo bakkahal im lav. may tama? dekaate merut hammoaviyya.
Amar leh avner, tenena: "ammoni", velo ammonit. "moavi", velo moavit. ella meatta: "mamzer", velo mamzeret? "mamzer" ketiv — mum zar.

"Mitzri", velo mitzrit! shane hacha, dimfaresh tama dikra: "al asher lo kiddemu etchem ballechem uvammayim" — darko shel ish lekaddem, velo darkah shel ishsha lekaddem. haya lahem lekaddem anashim likrat anashim venashim likrat nashim! ishtik.

Miyyad: "vayyomer hammelech sheal atta ben mi ze haalem". hatam kare leh "naar", hacha kare leh "elem"? hachi ka amar leh: halacha nitallema mimmecha — tze usheal bevet hammidrash. shaal, amaru leh: "ammoni", velo ammonit. "moavi", velo moavit.

a: Akshi lehu doeg kol hane kusheyayta, ishtiku. bae leachroze aleh. miyyad "vaamasa ven ish ushemo yitra hayyisreeli asher ba el avigal bat nachash", uchetiv, "yeter hayyishmeeli", amar rava: melammed shechagar charbo keyishmael, veamar: kol mi sheeno shomea halacha zo — yiddaker bacherev. kach mekubbelani mibbet dino shel shemuel haramati: "ammoni", velo ammonit. "moavi", velo moavit.
Umi meheman? vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav: kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva, im kodem maase amarah — shomin lo, veim lav — en shomin lo! shane hacha, deha shemuel uvet dino kayyaym.
Mikkol makom kashya! hacha targimu: "kol kevudda vat melech penima". bemareva amri, veittema rabbi yitzchak, amar kera: "vayyomru elav ayye sara ishtecha vegomer".
Ketannae: "ammoni", velo ammonit, "moavi", velo moavit, divre rabbi yehuda, rabbi shimon omer: "al devar asher lo kiddemu etchem ballechem uvammayim" — darko shel ish lekaddem vechulei.
Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "pittachta lemoseray" — amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, shene moserot shehayu alay, pittachtam: rut hammoaviyya venaama haammonit.

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "rabbot asita atta Adonai elohay nifleotecha umachshevotecha elenu". "elay" lo neemar, ella "elenu" — melammed shehaya rechavam yoshev becheko shel david, amar lo: alay vealecha neemru shete mikraot hallalu.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "az amarti hinne vati bimgillat sefer katuv alay", amar david: ani amarti "atta vati", velo yadati shebbimgillat sefer katuv alay". hatam ketiv: "hannimtzaot", hacha ketiv: "matzati david avdi beshemen kodshi meshachtiv".

Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: bat ger ammoni keshera lakkehunna. amar leh rava bar ulla leulla: keman? i kerabbi yehuda, ha amar: bat ger zachar — kevat chalal zachar! vei kerabbi yose, peshita, ha amar: af ger shennasa giyyoret — bitto keshera lichhunna.
Vechi tema, behanach diruyin lavo bakkahal, aval hay deen rauy lavo bakkahal — la, mena leh?
Deyalef mikkohen gadol bealmana. ma lechohen gadol bealmana — shekken biato baavera.
Chalal yochiach! ma lechalal shekken yetzirato baavera —
Kohen gadol yochiach. vechazar haddin:
Lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: sheeno berov kahal, uvitto pesula. af kan, sheeno berov kahal — uvitto pesula.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad avera!
Dilma vadday beammoni shennasa bat yisrael kaamrat, af al gav deviato baavera — bitto keshera! amar leh: in.

Dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: bat ger ammoni, uvat mitzri sheni, rabbi yochanan amar: keshera, veresh lakish amar: pesula. resh lakish amar pesula — deyalef la mikkohen gadol bealmana. rabbi yochanan amar keshera —
b: Detane rabbi zakkay kammeh derabbi yochanan: "ki im betula meammav yikkach ishsha", lehavi giyyoret mikkannah — shehi keshera lakkehunna. vaamar leh: ani shone "ammav", "meammav" — lehavi betula habbaa mishshene ammin, veat amrat giyyoret mikkannah vetu la?
May "shene ammin"? illema ammoni shennasa ammonit, umay mishshene ammin, dizcharim asurin unekevot muttarot, hayeynu giyyoret mikkannah. ella beammoni shennasa bat yisrael.
Veikka deamri, amar leh: ani shone "ammav" "meammav" — lehavi betula habbaa mishshene ammin, umeam sheyyesh bo shene ammin, veat amrat giyyoret mikkannah vetu la?
Ulehach lishshana, bat mitzri sheni, dichshera lichhunna mena leh? vechi tema deyalef meammoni shennasa bat yisrael: ma leammoni shennasa bat yisrael, shekken nekevot muttarot.
Mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit sheniyya yochiach!
Ma lemitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit sheniyya, shekken en biato baavera.
Ammoni shennasa bat yisrael yochiach. vechazar haddin vechulei.
Amar rav yosef: hayeynu dishmana leh lerav yehuda deamar "ammav" "meammav", vela yadana may kaamar.

Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar: hachi tanna kammeh: ishsha ammonit — keshera, benah meammoni — pasul, uvittah meammoni — keshera. bamme devarim amurim: beammoni veammonit shennitgayyeyru, aval bittah meammoni — pesula.
Amar leh: pok teni levara. may daamart ishsha ammonit keshera — "ammoni" velo ammonit. benah meammoni pasul — deha ammoni hu.
Uvittah meammoni keshera, lemay? ilema lavo bakkahal — hasheta immah keshera, hi mibbaya? ella lichhunna.

Bamme devarim amurim: beammoni veammonit shennitgayyeyru, aval bittah meammoni pesula. may bittah meammoni? illema ammoni shennasa ammonit — hayeynu giyyoret mikkannah! ella ammoni shennasa bat yisrael, amar leh: pok teni levara.
Mitzri vaadomi enan asurin vechulei. may teshuva?
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, mishshum deikka lememar: arayot yochichu, shello asar bahen ella ad shelosha dorot, echad zecharim veechad nekevot!
Ma laarayot, shekken karet! mamzer yochiach.
Ma lemamzer, shekken eno rauy lavo bakkahal leolam. arayot yochichu, vechazar haddin.
Lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheasurin, veechad zecharim veechad nekevot. af ani avi mitzri umitzrit sheyyihyu asurin, echad zecharim veechad nekevot.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yesh bahen tzad karet.
Verabbanan, mechalal dechayyayve ase, ucherabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Umay "la ki"? hachi kaamar lehu: ledidi, la sevira li derabbi eliezer ben yaakov. ledidchu, disvira lechu kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov — halacha ani omer.
Tanya, amar lahen rabbi shimon: halacha ani omer, veod: mikra mesayyeyeni, "banim" — velo banot.
Tanu rabbanan: "banim" velo banot, divre rabbi shimon. amar rabbi yehuda, hare hu omer: "banim asher yivvaldu lahem dor shelishi", hakkatuv telaan beleda.
Amar rabbi yochanan: i lav deamar rabbi yehuda hakkatuv telaan beleda — lo matza yadav veraglav bevet hammidrash. kevan deamar mar: kehal gerim ikkeri kahal,

a: Mitzri sheni bemay yithar? dilma dei avar unesev. "dei" la ketiv kera.
Hare mamzer "dei", vechatveh kera! "dei" leissura — ketav, "dei" lehettera — la ketav.
Hare machazir gerushato, "dei" lehettera vechatveh? hatam mishshum ikkar issura hu dechatveh.

Tanu rabbanan: im neemar "banim", lamma neemar "dorot"? veim neemar "dorot", lamma neemar "banim"? im neemar "banim" velo neemar "dorot", hayiti omer: ben rishon vesheni — asur, shelishi — muttar, lechach neemar "dorot".
Veim neemar "dorot" velo neemar "banim", hayiti omer leotan haomdim al har sinay, lechach neemar "banim".
"Lahem" — mehem mene. "lahem" — hallech achar pesulan.

Veitzterich lemichtav "lahem", veitzterich lemichtav "asher yivvaldu". dei ketav rachamana "asher yivvaldu", hava amena: mibbenehem mene, ketav rachamana "lahem". vei ketav rachamana "lahem", hava amena: mitzrit meubberet shennitgayyeyra — hi uvenah chad, ketav rachamana "asher yivvaldu".
Veitzterich lemichtav "lahem" hacha, veitzterich lemichtav "lo" gabbe mamzer.
Dei ketav rachamana hacha, mishshum deva mittippa pesula, aval mamzer deva mittippa keshera — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana gabbe mamzer, mishshum deen rauy lavo bakkahal leolam, aval hacha — ema la, tzericha.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona — benah shelishi have. alma kasavar batar dideh shadenan leh,

Metiv rav yosef, rabbi tarfon omer: yecholin mamzerim littaher. ketzad? mamzer nasa shifcha — havvalad eved. shichrero — nimtza ben chorin. alma batar dida shadenan leh! shane hatam, deamar kera: "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha".

Metiv rava, amar rabbi yehuda: minyamin ger mitzri haya li chaver mittalmide rabbi akiva, veamar: ani mitzri rishon, venasati mitzrit rishona, assi livne mitzrit sheniyya, kede sheyyehe ben beni rauy lavo bakkahal. vei salka datach batreh dideh shadenan leh — afillu rishona name! ha amar leh rabbi yochanan letanna: teni rishona.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona — benah sheni have. alma batar immeh shadenan leh.
Amar leh abbaye: ella ha deamar rabbi yochanan: hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda — ratza mitkapper bah, ratza mitkapper bivladah.
I amrat bishlama ubbar lav yerech immo hu — have leh kemafrish shete chattaot leachrayut, veamar rav oshaya: hifrish shete chattaot leachrayut — mitkapper beachat mehen, vehashsheniyya tire.
Ella i amrat ubbar yerech immo hu, have leh velad chattat, uvelad chattat lemita azel?
Ishtik. amar leh: dilma shane hatam, dichtiv: "asher yivvaldu", hakkatuv telao beleda. amar leh: karkafna, chazeteh lereshach bene ammude ki amar rabbi yochanan leha shemata.
Tama dichtiv "asher yivvaldu", ha bealma — batar avu shadenan leh. ella ha deamar rava: goya meubberet shennitgayyeyra — benah en tzarich tevila, ammay en tzarich tevila?
Vechi tema mishshum derabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: devar tora, rubbo umakpid alav — chotzetz, rubbo sheeno makpid alav — eno chotzetz.
b: Veha amar rav kahana: lo shanu ella rubbo, aval kullo — chotzetz! shane ubbar, dehayynu reviteh.

Ki ata ravina, amar rabbi yochanan: beummot, hallech achar hazzachar. nitgayyeyru, hallech achar pagum shebbishnehem. baummot hallech achar hazzachar, kidtanya: minnayin leechad min haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid ben, sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved — shenneemar: "vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu".

Yachol afillu echad min hakkenaanim shebba al achat min haummot veholid ben, sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved — talmud lomar: "asher holidu beartzechem" — min hannoladim beartzechem, velo min haggarim beartzechem.

Nitgayyeyru hallech achar pagum shebbishnehem. bemay? ilema bemitzri shennasa ammonit — may pagum shebbishnehem it ba? "ammoni" velo ammonit! ella beammoni shennasa mitzrit. i zachar have — shidyeh batar ammoni, i nekeva have — shidyay batar mitzrit.
Mishna mamzerin unetinin asurin, veissuran issur olam. echad zecharim veechad nekevot.
Gemara amar resh lakish: mamzeret leachar asara dorot mutteret. yalef "asiri" "asiri" meammoni umoavi. ma lehallan nekevot muttarot — af kan nekevot muttarot.
I: ma lehallan miyyad, af kan miyyad! ki ahani gezera shava, measiri veelach.
Vehaanan tenan: mamzerim unetinin asurin, veissuran issur olam, echad zecharim veechad nekevot! la kashya: ha keman deamar dun minna uminna.
Ha keman deamar dun minna veoke beatra.
Shaalu et rabbi eliezer: mamzeret leachar asra dare mahu? amar lahem: mi yitten li dor shelishi vaataharennu. alma kasavar mamzera la chaye. vechen amar rav huna: mamzera la chaye.

Veha anan tenan: mamzerin asurin, veissuran issur olam! amar rabbi zera: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derav yehuda: didia — chaye, dela yedia — la chaye. didia vela yedia — ad telata dare chaye, tefe — la chaye.
Hahu dehave beshivavuteh derabbi amme. achrez aleh demamzera hava. bache veazel, amar leh: chayyim natatti lach.
Amar rav chana bar adda: netinim — david gazar alehem, shenneemar: "vayyikra hammelech laggivonim vayyomer alehem vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma vegomer".

May tama gezar alayyhu? dichtiv: "vayhi raav bime david shalosh shanim shana achar shana". shana rishona amar lahem: shemma ovde avoda zara yesh bachem, dichtiv: "vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem. veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar vegomer". badku, velo matzu.
Sheniyya amar lahem: shemma ovre avera yesh bachem, dichtiv: "vayyimmanu revivim umalkosh lo haya umetzach ishsha zona haya lach vegomer". badku, velo matzu.
Shelishit amar lahem: shemma poske tzedaka barabbim yesh bachem veen notnin, dichtiv: "nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin ish mithallel bemattat shaker". badku, velo matzu.
Amar: en haddavar taluy ella bi, miyyad: "vayvakkesh david et pene Adonai". may hi? amar resh lakish: sheshshaal beurim vetummim.
May mashma? amar rabbi elazar: atya "pene" "pene". ketiv hacha: "vayvakkesh david et pene Adonai", uchetiv hatam: "veshaal lo bemishpat haurim lifne Adonai".

"Vayyomer Adonai el shaul veel bet haddamim al asher hemit haggivonim". "el shaul" — shello nispad kahalacha, "veel bet haddamim" — "al asher hemit haggivonim". vechi hechan matzinu beshaul shehemit haggivonim? ella mittoch sheharag nov ir hakkohanim shehayu maspikin lahem mayim umazon, maale alav hakkatuv keillu haragan.

Ka tava el shaul shello nispad kahalacha, veka tava al asher hemit haggivonim?! in, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv: "bakkeshu et Adonai kol anve eretz asher mishpato paalu", baasher mishpato — sham poolo.
Amar david: shaul, nefaku lehu

a: Teresar yarche shatta, vela darkeh lemispedeh.

Netinim nikrinhu unefayyeysinhu: "vayyikra hammelech laggivonim vayyomer alehem. ma eese lachem uvamma achapper uvarchu et nachalat Adonai. vayyomru lo haggivonim en lanu kesef vezahav im shaul veim beto veen lanu ish vegomer yuttan lanu shiva anashim mibbanav vehokaanum laAdonai vegomer", payyeysinhu vela mippayysu.

Amar, shelosha simanim yesh beumma zo: harachmanim, vehabbayyshanin, vegomle chasadim. rachmanim — dichtiv: "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha". bayyshanin — dichtiv: "baavur tihye yirato al penechem". gomle chasadim — dichtiv: "lemaan asher yetzavve et banav veet beto vegomer". kol sheyyesh bo shelosha simanim hallalu — rauy lehiddavek beumma zo.

"Vayyikkach hammelech et shene bene ritzpa vat ayya asher yalda leshaul et armoni veet mefivoshet veet chameshet bene michal bat shaul asher yalda leadriel ben barzillay hammecholati". may shena hane? amar rav huna: heevirum lifne aron, kol shearon kolto — lemita, kol sheen aron kolto — lechayyim.
Metiv rav chana bar kattina: "vayyachmol hammelech al mefivoshet ben yehonatan ben shaul" — shello heeviro.
Vechi masso panim yesh baddavar? ella: sheheeviro ukelato, uvikkesh alav rachamim, ufelato. veakkatti: masso panim yesh baddavar? ella, shebbikkesh rachamim shello yikletennu haaron.
Veha ketiv: "lo yumetu avot al banim vegomer"? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mutav shetteaker ot achat min hattora, veal yitchallel shem shamayim befarhesya.

"Vattikkach ritzpa vat ayya et hassak vattattehu lah el hatztzur mittechillat katzir ad nittach mayim alehem min hashshamayim velo natna of hashshamayim lanuach alehem yomam vechayyat hassade layla". veha ketiv: "lo talin nivlato al haetz"!

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: mutav shetteaker ot achat min hattora, veyitkaddesh shem shamayim befarhesya. shehayu ovrim veshavim omrim: ma tivan shel ellu? hallalu bene melachim hem. uma asu? pashtu yedehem begerim gerurim. amru: en lecha umma sheruya lehiddavek bah kazo. uma bene melachim kach — bene hedyotot al achat kamma vechamma! uma gerim gerurim kach — yisrael al achat kamma vechamma!

Miyyad nittosfu al yisrael mea vachamishshim elef, shenneemar: "vayhi lishlomo shivim elef nose sabbal ushemonim elef chotzev bahar". vedilma yisrael havo? la salka datach, dichtiv: "umibbene yisrael lo natan shelomo aved".

Vedilma dugezar bealma. ella mehacha: "vayyispor shelomo kol haanashim haggerim asher beeretz yisrael [vegomer] vayyimmatzu mea vachamishshim elef [vegomer] vayyaas mehem shivim elef (nose) sabbal ushemonim elef chotzev bahar".
Unetinim david gazar alehem? moshe gazar alehem, dichtiv: "mechotev etzecha ad shoev memecha"! moshe gezar lehahu dara, david gezar lechulle dare.

Veakkatti yehoshua gezar alayyhu, dichtiv: "vayyittenem yehoshua bayyom hahu chotve etzim veshoave mayim laeda ulemizbach Adonai"! yehoshua gazar bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, david gazar bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym.
b: Bime rabbi bikkeshu lehattir netinim. amar lahem rabbi: chelkenu nattir, chelek mizbeach mi yattir?

Ufeliga derabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: chelek eda — leolam asur, chelek mizbeach, bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — asur, en bet hammikdash kayyaym — shere.
Mishna amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati shehassaris choletz vecholtzin leishto, vehassaris lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, veen li lefaresh.
Amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh: seris adam — choletz vecholtzin leishto, mippene shehayta lo sheat hakkosher. seris chamma — lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, mippene shello hayta lo sheat hakkosher.
Rabbi eliezer omer: lo chi, ella: seris chamma — choletz vecholtzin leishto, mippene sheyyesh lo refua. seris adam — lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, mippene sheen lo refua.
Heid rabbi yehoshua ben betera al ben megusat shehaya birushalayim seris adam, veyibbemu et ishto, lekayyem divre rabbi akiva.
Hassaris — lo choletz velo meyaybem, vechen ayylonit — lo choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Hassaris shechalatz livimto — lo pesalah. bealah — pesalah, mippene shehi beilat zenut. vechen ayylonit shechaltzu lah achin — lo pesaluha. bealuha — pesaluha, mippene shebbeilatah beilat zenut.
Gemara mikkedi shaminan lerabbi akiva deamar chayyayve lavin kechayyayve karetot damu, vechayyayve karetot lav bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu!
Amar rabbi amme: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shennasa achiv giyyoret, verabbi akiva savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: kehal gerim — la ikkeri kahal.
I hachi, yabbome name meyaybem! in hachi name, veayyeyde deamar rabbi yehoshua choletz, amar ihu name choletz.
Dayka name, dekatane: heid rabbi yehoshua ben betera al ben megusat shehaya birushalayim seris adam, veyibbemu et ishto lekayyem divre rabbi akiva. shema minna.

Metiv rabba: petzua dakka ucherut shofcha, seris adam vehazzaken — o choltzin o meyaybmin. ketzad: metu velahem nashim, velahem achin, veamdu achin veasu maamar binshotehen, venatnu get, o shechaltzu — ma sheasu asu, veim baalu — kanu.

Metu achin, veamdu hen veasu maamar binshotehen, venatnu get o chaltzu — ma sheasu asu. veim baalu — kanu, veasur lekayyeyman, mishshum shenneemar: "lo yavo fetzua dakka ucherut shofcha bikhal Adonai", alma bekahal askinan!
Ella amar rabba: kegon shennafla lo, ulevassof niftza.
Amar leh abbaye: velayte issur patzua venidche ase deyibbum! mi la tenan, rabban gamliel omer: im meana — meana,
Veim lav — tamtin ad shettagdil, vetetze hallezu mishshum achot ishsha. alma: ate issur achot ishsha vedache. hacha name: nete issur patzua venidche!
Ella amar rav yosef: hay tanna — hach tanna deve rabbi akiva hi, deamar: mechayyayve lavin disher have mamzer, mechayyayve lavin geridi la have mamzer.
Ikkeri kan "lehakim leachiv shem", veha lav bar hachi hu?
Amar rava: im ken, en lecha ishsha shekkeshera leyabbem, shello naasa balah seris chamma shaa achat kodem lemitato!
Lerabbi eliezer, peruka derava pircha hi!
Hatam kechishuta deatchila beh.
Hechi dame seris chamma? amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: kol

a: Shello raa shaa achat bechashruto. mena yadinan? amar abbaye: kol hammetil mayim veeno ose kippa.
Mimmay havey? deafya immeh betihara veshatya shichra marka. amar rav yosef: hayeynu deshamana leimmi deamar: "kol shemmimmee immo lakuy", vela yadana may nihu.
Velechush shemma hivri benatayim! kevan ditchillato vesofo lakuy — la chayyshinan.
Metiv rav mari, rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: bodkin oto shalosh peamim betoch shemonim yom!
Lechad ever chayyshinan, lechulleh gufa la chayyshinan.

Rabbi eliezer omer lo ki vechulei. ureminhu: ben esrim shana velo hevi shete searot — yaviu reaya shehu ben esrim, vehu hassaris — lo choletz velo meyaybem. bat esrim velo hevia shete searot — yaviu reaya shehi bat esrim, vehi haaylonit — lo choletzet velo mityaybemet, divre bet hillel. uvet shammay omrim: ze veze bene shemone esre.
Rabbi eliezer omer: hazzachar kedivre bet hillel, unekeva kedivre bet shammay, mippene shehaishsha memaheret lavo lifne haish!

Amar rame bar dikkule amar shemuel: chazar bo rabbi eliezer. ibbaya lehu: mehe hadar beh? ta shema, detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: seris chamma — choletz vecholtzin leishto, shekken beminan mitrappein baalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim.
Rabbi elazar omer: leolam la hadar beh. vechi tenan hahi — laonashin.

Ittemar: achal chelev, mibben shetem esre [veyom echad] ad ben shemone esre, venoldu bo simane saris, uleachar mikkan hevi shete searot. rav amar: naase saris lemafrea. ushemuel amar: katan haya beotah shaa.
Matkef la rav yosef: lerav, aylonit lerabbi meir yehe lah kenas!
Amar leh abbaye: mikkatnutah yatzta leveger.

Amar leh: kol ki hane mille mealleyayta yitammeru mishshemay. detanya: en hassaris niddon keven sorer umore — lefi sheen ben sorer umore niddon ella bachatimat zakan hattachton. veen aylonit niddonet kenaara hameorasa — shemmikkatnutah yatzta leveger.
Amar rabbi avahu: simane saris, veaylonit uven shemone en osin bahen maase — ad sheyyehu ben esrim.
Uven shemone mi kachaye? vehatanya: ben shemone — hare hu keeven, veasur letaltelo, aval immo shocha alav umenikato
b: Mippene hassakkana. hacha bemay askinan — kesheggamru simanav. detanya: ezehu ben shemone? kol shello kalu lo chodashav. rabbi omer: simanin mochichin alav, searo vetzippornav shello gamru. tama delo gamru. ha gamru — amrinan hay bar shiva hu, veishtahoye hu deishtahi.
Ella ha daavad rava tosfaa ovada beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam veishtahi ad teresar yarche shatta, veachshereh. keman — kerabbi, deamar mishtahe!
Kevan deikka rabban shimon ben gamliel deamar mishtahe, kerabbim avad. detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam — eno nefel.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu seris chamma? kol shehu ben esrim, velo hevi shete searot. vaafillu hevi leachar mikkan hare hu kesaris lechol devarav. veellu hen simanav: kol sheen lo zakan, usearo lakuy, uvesaro machlik. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yehuda ben yair: kol sheen memav maalin retichot.

Veyesh omrim: kol hammetil mayim veen ose kippa. veyesh omrim: kol sheshshichvat zaro docha. veyesh omrim: kol sheen meme raglav machmitzin. acherim omrim: kol sherochetz bimot haggeshamim veen besaro maale hevel. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol shekkolo lakuy, veen nikkar ben ish leishsha.

Veezo hi aylonit? kol shehi bat esrim velo hevia shete searot, vaafillu hevia leachar mikkan — hare hi keaylonit lechol devareha. veellu hen simaneha: kol sheen lah daddim, umitkashsha bishat tashmish. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheen lah shippule meayim kenashim. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol shekkola ave, veenah nikkeret ben ishsha leish.

Ittemar: simane saris, rav huna amar: ad sheyyehu kullam. rabbi yochanan amar: afillu beechad mehen. hecha dehevi shete searot bazzakan — kulle alma la peligi dead sheyyehu kullan. ki peligi — beshello hevi.
Ella ha daamar lehu rabba bar avu lerabbanan: ayyinu beh berav nachman, i besaro maale hevel ittev leh berat. keman, kerav huna! la, rav nachman sikke dikna haveya leh.

Hassaris lo choletz velo meyaybem, vechen aylonit vechulei. katane saris dumeya deaylonit: ma aylonit bide shamayim, af saris bide shamayim. usetama kerabbi akiva, deamar: bide adam — in, bide shamayim — la.
Hassaris shechalatz livimto lo pesalah kulei. tama divalah hu, ha acher — la,

a: Lema tehve teyuveta derav hamenuna, deamar: shomeret yavam shezzinneta pesula livamah! lo: hu haddin afillu leacher name, veayyeyde ditna resha bedideh, tena name sefa bedideh.
Vechen ayylonit shechaltzu lah achin kulei. tama divaluha. ha lo bealuha — la. keman? dela kerabbi yehuda, dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: ayylonit zona hi.
Mishna seris chamma kohen shennasa bat yisrael — maachilah bitruma. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: anderoginos kohen shennasa bat yisrael — maachilah bitruma.
Rabbi yehuda omer: tumetum shennikra venimtza zachar — lo yachlotz, mippene shehu kesaris. anderoginos nose aval lo nissa. rabbi eliezer omer: anderoginos chayyayvin alav sekila kazzachar.
Gemara peshita? mahu detema: molid — maachil, sheeno molid — eno maachil, ka mashma lan.

Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: anderoginos. amar resh lakish: maachilah bitruma, veen maachilah bechaze vashok. rabbi yochanan omer: af maachilah bechaze vashok. uleresh lakish, may shena chaze vashok — deorayyta? teruma name deorayyta!

Hacha bemay askinan — bitruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan. aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym may — lo? addetane "en maachilah bechaze vashok", liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — bitruma derabbanan, aval bitruma deorayyta — la!
Hachi name kaamar: keshehu maachilah — maachilah bitruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan, veen maachilah bizman chaze vashok, vaafillu bitruma derabbanan, dilma ate leochola bitruma deorayyta.
Verabbi yochanan amar: af maachilah bechaze vashok. amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: mi savrat teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan? amar leh: in, sheani shone: iggul beiggulim ole.
Amar leh, vahalo ani shone: chaticha bachatichot — ola. mi savrat "kol sheddarko limmanot" shaninu? "et sheddarko limmanot" shaninu.
May hi — ditnan: mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem — yidleku. nitarvu baacherot —
b: Kullan yiddalku, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yaalu beechad umatayim. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol sheddarko limmanot — mekaddesh. vachachamim omrim: eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad. rabbi akiva omer: shiva.

Ellu hen: egoze ferech, verimmone badan, vechaviyyot setumot, vechilfe teradin, vekuleche keruv, vedallaat yevanit. verabbi akiva mosif af kikkarot shel baal habbayit. haruyin leorla — orla. lechile hakkerem — kile hakkerem.
Rabbi yochanan savar: "et sheddarko limmanot" shaninu. veresh lakish savar: "kol sheddarko limmanot" shaninu.

May chaticha — detanya: chaticha shel chattat temea shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chattaot tehorot, vechen perusa shel lechem happanim temea shennitarva bemea perusot shel lechem happanim tehorot — taale. rabbi yehuda omer: lo taale.
Aval chaticha shel chattat tehora shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chullin tehorot, vechen perusa shel lechem happanim tehora shennitarva bemea perusot shel chullin tehorot — divre hakkol la taale.
Katane mihat resha taale! amar rabbi chiyyay bereh derav huna: benimmocha.
I hachi, may tama derabbi yehuda?

a: Rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: min bemino lo batel.

Aval lo nimmocha may — lo taale, addetane: aval chaticha shel chattat tehora shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chullin tehorot lo taale, niflog venitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim, beshennimmocha, aval lo nimmocha — lo taale!
Tehorot bithorot adif leh.
Uleresh lakish, may shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: resha, betumeat mashkin derabbanan. sefa, deorayyta.
Aval tumeat sheretz may — lo taale,

Addetane sefa: aval chaticha shel chattat tehora shennitarva bemea chatichot shel chullin tehorot lo taale, niflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — betumeat mashkin, aval betumeat sheretz — lo! tehora bithorot adif leh.
Rabba amar: resha — issur lav, sefa — issur karet.
Veha rabba hu deamar: kol bidorayyta, la shena issur lav, vela shena issur karet! kashya.
Rav ashe amar: sefa — mishshum dehave leh davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin — afillu beelef lo batel.
Veha derav ashe beduta hi. leman? i lechohen — mishra shere. i leyisrael — leolam asur! ella ha derav ashe beduta hi.

Vesavar rabbi yochanan teruma bizman hazze deorayyta? vehatanya: shete kuppot, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, velifnehem shete sein, achat shel chullin veachat shel teruma, venaflu ellu betoch ellu — hare ellu muttarim, sheani omer: teruma letoch teruma nafla, vechullin betoch chullin naflu.
Veamar resh lakish: vehu sherabbu chullin al hatteruma, verabbi yochanan amar: af al pi shello rabbu chullin al hatteruma.
Bishlama leresh lakish, kasavar bidrabbanan name ribbuya hu devaenan. ella lerabbi yochanan kashya?
Ha manni — rabbanan hi,
b: Vaana deamri kerabbi yose.
Detanya beseder olam: "asher yarshu avotecha virishtah", yerushsha rishona usheniyya — yesh lahen, ushelishit — en lahen.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: man tena seder olam — rabbi yose.

Vesavar rabbi yochanan bidrabbanan la baenan ribbuya? veha tenan: mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuuonot, natan sea venatal sea — kasher. veamar rabbi yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: ad rubbo.
May lav, denishtayyer rubbo! la, dela nishkol rubbo.
Veibbaet ema: shane hacha, deikka lememar "sheani omer".
Tenan: anderoginos nose! teni "im nasa".
Veha "nose" katane! velitamaych: may "aval lo nissa"? ella may "nissa" — diavad, "nose" name — diavad!
Amri, la: "nose" — lechattechilla mashma, "aval lo nissa" — diavad name la.
Veha middekatane sefa, rabbi eliezer omer: anderoginos chayyayvin alav sekila kazzachar, mikkelal detanna kamma sappoke mesappeka leh!
Ben lemar ben lemar mifshat peshita leh, ikka benayyhu sekila mishshene mekomot. demar savar: chayyayvin alav sekila mishshene mekomot, umar savar: kezachar.
Amar rav:

a: Leta lematnitin mikkamme barayyta, detanya: rabbi yose omer: anderoginos — beriyya bifne atzmah hu, velo hichriu bo chachamim im zachar im nekeva.
Adderabba leta levarayyta mikkamme matnitin! middeshavkeh rabbi yose levar zugeh — shema minna hadar beh.

Ushemuel amar: leta levarayyta mikkamme matnitin. adderabba, leta lematnitin mikkamme barayyta, deha shaminan leh lishmuel dechayesh lichidaa! hane mille, ki la mitakra matnitin, aval ki mitakra matnitin — la chayesh.
Amri be rav mishshemeh derav: halacha kerabbi yose beanderoginos uveharkava, ushemuel amar: bekoshi uvekiddush.

Anderoginos — ha daamaran. harekava — ditnan: en notin veen mavrichin veen markivin erev sheviit pachot mishsheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana. veim nata vehivrich vehirkiv — yaakor. rabbi yehuda omer: kol harekava sheenah koletet bishlosha yamim — shuv enah koletet. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: shete shabbatot.

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ledivre haomer sheloshim — tzarich sheloshim vshloshim. ledivre haomer shelosha — tzarich shelosha vshloshim. ledivre haomer shete shabbatot — tzarich shete shabbatot usheloshim.
Ushemuel amar: bekoshi vekiddush. koshi — ditnan:
Kamma yehe kishshuyah — rabbi meir omer: o arbaim o chamishshim yom. rabbi yehuda omer: dayyay chodshah. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: en kishshuy yoter mishshete shabbatot.
Kiddush — ditnan: hamesakkech gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero — hare ze kiddesh, vechayyayv beachrayuto, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim:
b: En adam oser davar sheeno shello.
Ibbaya lehu: beanderoginos ma li amar shemuel? ta shema, deamar shemuel lerav anan: leta levarayyta mikkamme matnitin.
Harekava ma li amar shemuel? ta shema, daamar leh shemuel lerav anan: teni keman deamar shelosha usheloshim.
Koshi ma li amar rav? teku.

Kiddush ma li amar rav? amar rav yosef: ta shema, deamar rav huna amar rav: en halacha kerabbi yose. amar leh abbaye: may chazet desamchat aha? semoch aha! deamar rav adda amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose. "amri be rav" — mannu? rav huna, verav huna amar: en halacha.

Rabbi yehuda omer: tumetum vechulei. amar rabbi amme: may aved leh rabbi yehuda letumetum devere, deotvu abbe kuresya veikkera, veoled sheva benin! verabbi yehuda amar lach: chazzer al banav meayin hem.

Tanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: tumetum lo yachlotz, shemma yikkara venimtza seris chamma. attu kol demikkera zachar have? hachi kaamar: shemma yikkara venimtza nekeva, vaafillu nimtza zachar — shemma yimmatze saris chamma.
May benayyhu? amar rava: lifsol bimkom achin velachlotz shello bimkom achin ikka benayyhu.

Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi abba achu derabbi yehuda bar zavdi amar rav yehuda amar rav: anderoginos chayyayvin alav sekila, mishshete mekomot. metivi, rabbi eliezer amar: anderoginos chayyayvin alav sekila kazzachar. bamme devarim amurim — bezachrut shello, aval benakvut shello — patur!

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi simay omer: anderoginos chayyayvin alav sekila mishshete mekomot. may tama derabbi simay? amar rava: bar hamedure asbera li: "veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha", e zehu zachar sheyyesh bo shene mishkavot — heve omer ze anderoginos.
Verabbanan, af al gav deit beh shene mishkavot — "et zachar" ketiv.
Verabbanan, zachar gereda mena lehu? meishsha". beishsha shello kedarkah mena lehu? mivveishsha".
Amar rav shezvi amar rav chisda: lo lakkol amar rabbi eliezer anderoginos zachar mealleya hu, sheim atta omer ken, bemukedashin — yikdash.
Umenalan dela kadesh — detanu rabbanan: hannirba vehammuketze vehanneevad vehaetnan umechir vetumetum veanderoginos — metammein begadim abbet habbelia.

Rabbi eliezer omer: tumetum veanderoginos en metammein begadim abbet habbelia. shehaya rabbi eliezer omer: kol makom shenneemar zachar unekeva — atta motzi tumetum veanderoginos mibbenehem. veof, hoil velo neemar bo zachar unekeva — i atta motzi tumetum veanderoginos mibbenehem.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena, rabbi eliezer omer:

a: Hakkilayim uterefa veyotze dofen, tumetum veanderoginos — lo kedoshin velo makdishin.
Veamar shemuel: lo kedoshin — bitmura. velo makdishin — beose temura. shema minna.

Rabbi eliezer omer: chayyayvin alav sekila kazzachar. tanya, amar rabbi: keshehalachti lilmod tora etzel rabbi elazar ben shammua, chavru alay talmidav ketarnegolim shel bet bukeya, velo hinnichuni lilmod ella davar echad bemishnatenu — rabbi eliezer omer: anderoginos chayyayvin alav sekila kazzachar.
Hadaran alach hearel
Yesh muttarot levalehen vaasurot leyivmehen, muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen. muttarot laellu velaellu, vaasurot laellu velaellu.
Veellu muttarot levalehen vaasurot leyivmehen: kohen hedyot shennasa et haalmana, veyesh lo ach kohen gadol; chalal shennasa keshera, veyesh lo ach kasher;
Yisrael shennasa bat yisrael, veyesh lo ach mamzer; mamzer shennasa mamzeret, veyesh lo ach yisrael — muttarot levalehen vaasurot leyivmehen.

Veellu muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen: kohen gadol shekkiddesh et haalmana, veyesh lo ach kohen hedyot; kasher shennasa chalala, veyesh lo ach chalal; yisrael shennasa mamzeret, veyesh lo ach mamzer; mamzer shennasa bat yisrael, veyesh lo ach yisrael — muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen.

Veellu asurot laellu velaellu: kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana, veyesh lo ach kohen gadol; o kohen hedyot kasher shennasa chalala, veyesh lo ach kasher; yisrael shennasa mamzeret, veyesh lo ach yisrael; mamzer shennasa bat yisrael, veyesh lo ach mamzer — asurot laellu velaellu, ushear kol hannashim muttarot levalehen uleyivmehen.

Sheniyyot middivre sofrim, sheniyyay labbaal velo sheniyyay layyavam — asura labbaal, umutteret layyavam. sheniyyay layyavam velo sheniyyay labbaal — asura layyavam umutteret labbaal, sheniyyay laze velaze — asura laze velaze.
En lah lo ketuva velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot. vehavvalad kasher, vechofin oto lehotzi.
Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer — yesh lahen ketubba.
Gemara may irya detane "nasa"? litne "kiddesh"!
Vechi tema: tama denasa — dehave leh ase velo taase, aval kiddesh — ate ase vedoche lo taase, veha kulle pirkin ase velo taase hu, vela ate ase vedache lo taase!
Mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa "kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana", davka nasa — deshavveyay chalalah, aval kiddesh — sharya leh, tanna name resha "nasa"!

Veaddetane mishshum sefa, litne mishshum metziata: kohen gadol shekkiddesh et haalmana veyesh lo ach kohen hedyot! ella mishshum bat buketa, dekavae lemitne "chalal shennasa keshera", tama denasa — deshavveyay chalala, aval kiddesh — sharya leh, mishshum hachi katane "nasa".
Umay irya dekatane almana? litne betula!
b: Vechi tema: kasavar hay tanna nissuin harishonim mappilin — hare chalal shennasa keshera, vela amrinan nissuin harishonim mappilin!

Ha vadday mishshum sefa, mishshum dekavae lemitna sefa: kohen gadol shennasa et haalmana, veyesh lo ach kohen gadol o kohen hedyot. davka almana — aval betula chazya leh, mishshum hachi katane almana.
Matkef la rav pappa: im ita leha dechi ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona — benah sheni have, litne name:
