Mitzri sheni shennasa shete mitzriyyot, achat rishona veachat sheniyyay, vehayu lo banim merishona usheniyyay. i nesuv ki orchayyhu — muttarot levalehen vaasurot leyivmehen.
Vei efuch unesuv — muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levalehen. muttarot laellu velaellu — giyyorot. asurot laellu velaellu — ayloniyyot!
Tena veshayyayr. may shayyayr dehay shayyayr? shayyayr petzua dakka.
I mishshum petzua dakka — lav shiyyura, deha tena leh chayyayve lavin!
Attu chayyayve lavin mi la katane vahadar tane? veha katane kohen hedyot shennasa almana, vechalal shennasa keshera!
Hahu, itztericha leh leashmoinan kidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo huzeharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin.
Veha katane: chalal shennasa keshera, veyisrael shennasa bat yisrael veyesh lo ach mamzer! ha name, la mihdar mitna hi, deishmuinan lav sheen shave bakkol, vekamashma lan lav hashshave bakkol.
Ha katane: yisrael shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael (umamzer shennasa mamzeret veyesh lo ach yisrael), ella lav, shema minna tena veshayyayr. shema minna.
Gufa. amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo huzeharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin. lema mesayyay leh: chalal shennasa keshera, may lav kohenet [haruya lo], umay "keshera" — keshera lichhunna?
La, yisreelit. umay "keshera" — keshera lakkahal.
I hachi: "yesh lo ach kasher", name kasher lakkahal, mikkelal dehu pasul lakkahal! ella lav — kohen, umiddehu kohen, hi kohenet! midde irya — ha kidita veha kidita.
Metiv ravin bar nachman: "lo yikkachu ... lo yikkachu", melammed shehaishsha muzeheret al yede haish!
Amar rava: kol hecha dehu muzehar — hi muzeheret, vechol hecha dehu lo muzehar — hi lo muzeheret.

Veha mehacha nafka? midderav yehuda amar rav nafka! deamar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: "ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam" — hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora!
I mehahi, hava amena: lav hashshave bakkol. aval lav sheeno shave bakkol, la.

a: Vahare tumea, delav sheen shave bakkol, vetama dichtav rachamana "bene aharon" velo benot aharon, ha lav hachi, hava amena nashim chayyayvot, may tama? lav mishshum derav yehuda amar rav?
La, degamrinan millo yikkachu".
Ikka deamri: kicha itztericha leh, salka datach amena: ligmar mittumea — kamashma lan.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua ikkelau lehintzevu, leatreh derav idi bar avin. beo minnayyhu: huzeharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin, o la?

Amar lehu rav pappa, tenetuha: asara yuchasin alu mibbavel: kohanim, leviyyim, veyisreelim, chalalim, gerim, vacharurim, umamzerim, netinim, shetuke, vaasufe. kohanim leviyyim yisreelim — muttarin lavo ze baze. leviyyim, yisreelim, chalalim, gerim, charurim — muttarin lavo ze baze. gere, charore, umamzere, netine, shetuke, vaasufe — muttarim lavo ze baze. veillu kohenet lechalal — la katane.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kol hecha dehane nasvi mehane vehane nasvi mehane — katane. kohen, kevan deillu bae leminsav chalala asira leh — la katane. ato lekammeh derav idi bar avin. amar lehu: dardeke, hachi amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo huzeharu kesherot linnase lifsulim.

Sheniyyot middivre sofrim vechulei. beo minneh bene vere merav sheshet: sheniyya labbaal velo sheniyya layyavam, yesh lah ketubba miyyavam o la? kevan deamar mar: ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon — let la,
O dilma: kevan deillu let la merishon, takkinu la rabbanan mishsheni — it la?
Amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetuha: ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon. veim hayta sheniyya labbaal — afillu miyyavam en lah.

Mikkelal deikka deit la miyyavam? chassore michassera, vehachi katane: ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon, vei let la merishon — takkinu la mishsheni. veim hayta sheniyya labbaal — afillu miyyavam en lah.

Bea minneh rabbi elazar merabbi yochanan: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, yesh lahen mezonot o en lahen mezonot? hechi dame: illema deyatva tuteh, baamod vehotze" kae, mezonot it la? la tzericha, shehalach hu limdinat hayyam, velavta veachla. may?
Mezone tenay ketuva ninhu, middeit la ketuva it la mezone, o dilma: ketubba dilmishkal umippak — it la, mezone, dilma tiakkav gabbeh — let la? amar leh: let la.
Vehatanya: yesh lah! ki tanya hahi — leachar mita.
It deamar: amar leh, tanya: yesh lah. ha baamod vehotze" kae? veella, hatanya yesh lah! ki tanya hahi, leachar mita.

Tanu rabbanan: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot — yesh lah ketubba, perot, mezonot, belaot, vehi pesula, uveladah pasul, vechofin oto lehotzi. sheniyyot middivre sofrim — en lah ketubba, lo perot, lo mezonot, velo belaot, vehi keshera, uveladah kasher, vechofin oto lehotzi.
Amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: mippene ma amru almana lechohen gadol yesh lah ketubba — mippene shehu pasul vehi pesula. vechol makom shehu pasul vehi pesula —
b: Kansu oto ketubba. umippene ma amru sheniyyot middivre sofrim en lahen ketubba — mippene shehu kasher vehi keshera. vechol makom shehu kasher vehi keshera — kansu otah ketubba.
Rabbi omer: hallalu divre tora — vedivre tora en tzerichin chizzuk. vehallalu divre sofrim — vedivre sofrim tzerichin chizzuk. davar acher: ze — hu margilah, vezo — hi margilato.

Davar acher man katane la? ikka deamar: rabbi shimon ben elazar katane la, uma taam kaamar. ma taam amru hu pasul vehi pesula kansu oto ketubba — mippene shehu margilah. uma taam hu kasher vehi keshera kansu otah ketubba — mippene shehi margilato.
Ikka deamar: rabbi katane la, vachalutza ka kashya leh: veha chalutza derabbanan, veit la ketubba! hadar amar: kevan defasel lah midderabbanan, ze — hu margilah, vezo — hi margilato.
May ikka ben rabbi lerabbi shimon ben elazar? amar rav chisda: mamzeret unetina leyisrael ikka benayyhu.
Man deamar deorayyta — ha name deorayyta, man deamar mippene shehu margilah — ha hi margela leh.

Ulerabbi eliezer deamar hare ze eved umamzer, ha la margela leh vela midde! ella amar rav yosef: machazir gerusha mishshennisset ikka benayyhu. man deamar deorayyta — ha name deorayyta, uman deamar mippene shehu margilah — ha hi margela leh.

Ulerabbi akiva deamar yesh mamzer mechayyayve lavin, ha la margela leh vela midde! ella amar rav pappa: beula lechohen gadol ikka benayyhu. man deamar deorayyta — ha name deorayyta, uman deamar mippene shehu margilah — ha hi margela leh.
Ulerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar yesh chalal mechayyayve ase, ha la margela leh vela midde! ella amar rav ashe: machazir safek sotato ikka benayyhu.

Man deamar deorayyta — ha name deorayyta, uman deamar mippene shehu margilah — ha hi margela leh. ulerabbi matya ben charash, deamar: afillu halach balah lehashekotah, uva aleha badderech — asaah zona, ha la margela leh vela midde! ella amar mar bar rav ashe: sota vadday ikka benayyhu.

Mishna bat yisrael meoreset lechohen, meubberet mikkohen, shomeret yavam lechohen, vechen bat kohen leyisrael — lo tochal bitruma. bat yisrael meoreset lelevi, meubberet millevi, shomeret yavam lelevi, vechen bat levi leyisrael — lo tochal bemaaser.
Bat levi meoreset lechohen, meubberet mikkohen, shomeret yavam lechohen, vechen bat kohen lelevi — lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser.
Gemara utehe zara, zara mi la achla bemaaser?! amar rav nachman amar shemuel: ha manni — rabbi meir hi, deamar: maaser rishon asur lezarim. detanya:

a: Teruma lechohen, umaaser rishon lelevi, divre rabbi meir. rabbi elazar ben azarya mattiro lechohen. mattiro?! mikkelal deikka man deasar? ella ema: notno af lechohen.

May tama derabbi meir? amar rav acha bereh derabba mishshemeh digmara: "ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai teruma". ma teruma asura lezarim, af maaser rishon asur lezarim. i ma teruma chayyayvin alav mita vachomesh — af maaser chayyayvin alav mita vachomesh?
Amar kera: "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu", "veyasaf chamishito alav". "bo" — velo bemaaser, "alav" — velo al maaser. verabbanan, ma teruma tovelet, af maaser rishon name tovel.

Vechidtanya, rabbi yose omer: yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella al tevel shello huram mimmennu kol ikkar. huram mimmennu teruma gedola velo huram mimmennu maaser rishon maaser rishon velo maaser sheni, vaafillu masar ani, minnayin?

Talmud lomar: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha", ulehallan hu omer: "veachlu visharecha vesaveu". ma "shearecha" haamur lehallan — masar ani, af "shearecha" haamur kan — masar ani, veamar rachamana "lo tuchal".
Vei mehatam, hava amena lelav, aval mita — la, ka mashma lan.
Lishshana acharina: maaser rishon detavel, midderabbi yose nafka! i mehahi, hava amena lelav, aval mita — la, ka mashma lan.

Bemay okemta — kerabbi meir, ema sefa: bat levi meoreset lechohen, uvat kohen lelevi — lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser, hacha may zarut ikka! amar rav sheshet: may "enah ochelet" dekatane — enah notenet reshut litrom.
Michlal dinsua notenet reshut? in, vehatanya: "vaachaltem oto bechol makom attem uvetchem" — limmed al nesua bat yisrael shennotenet reshut litrom.
Atta omer reshut litrom, o eno ella leechol? amrat: teruma chamura ochelet, maaser hakkal lo kol shekken?! ella limmed al nesua bat yisrael shennotenet reshut litrom.
Mar bereh deravna amar: lomar sheen cholkin lah maaser bevet haggeranot. hanicha leman deamar mishshum yichud, ella leman deamar mishshum gerusha, gerusha bat levi mi la achla bemaaser?!
Velitamaych, gerusha bat kohen mi la achla bitruma? ella gezera mishshum gerusha bat yisrael.
I hachi, may irya meoreset? afillu nesua name! ayyeyde ditna resha meoreset, tena name sefa meoreset.
Tanu rabbanan: teruma lechohen, umaaser rishon lelevi, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer:
b: Lechohen. lechohen velo lelevi? ema af lechohen. may tama derabbi akiva — dichtiv: "veel haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem", bilviyyim ka mishtae kera. veiddach kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim leviyyim, veze echad mehem: "vehakkohanim haleviyyim bene tzadok".

Verabbi akiva, hacha la matzet amrat, dichtiv: "vaachaltem oto bechol makom", mi sheyyachol leochlo bechol makom. yatza kohen, sheen yachol leochlo bevet hakkevarot. veiddach? kol hecha devae — dela bae choma, vei achel leh betumeat hagguf — la lake.
Hahi ginneta dahava shakel rabbi elazar ben azarya maaser rishon minna. azal rabbi akiva ahdereh lefitcha leve kivre. amar: akiva betarmilo, vaana chaye?
Ittemar, mippene ma kansu leviyyim bemaaser? peligi ba rabbi yonatan vesavayya. chad amar: shello alu bime ezra. vechad amar: kede sheyyismechu kohanim alav bime tumeatan.

Bishlama leman deamar shello alu — mishshum hachi kansinhu. ella leman deamar kede sheyyismechu alav kohanim bime tumeatan — mishshum kohanim kansinhu lalviyyim?! ella kulle alma kenasa shello alu bime ezra. vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar: kenasa laaniyyim, umar savar: kohanim bime tumeatan — aniyyim ninhu.

Bishlama leman deamar kenasa laaniyyim — mishshum hachi ahdereh rabbi akiva lefitcha leve kivre. ella leman deamar lechohanim, ammay ahdereh lefitcha leve kivre? hachi kaamar leh: i deka atet betorat kenasa — it lach, vei ka atet betorat chalukka — let lach.

Umena lan dela seliku bime ezra? dichtiv: "vaekbetzem el hannahar habba al ahava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina vaam uvakkohanim umibbene levi lo matzati sham". amar rav chisda: battechilla lo hayu meamidim shotrim ella min haleviyyim, shenneemar: "veshotrim haleviyyim lifnechem", achshav en maamidin shotrim ella miyyisrael, shenneemar: "veshotrim harabbim berashechem".

Mishna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen — tochal bitruma. met velah hemennu ben — tochal bitruma. nisset lelevi — tochal bemaaser. met velah hemennu ben — tochal bemaaser. nisset leyisrael — lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser. met velah hemennu ben — lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser.
Met benah miyyisrael — tochal bemaaser. met benah millevi — tochal bitruma. met benah mikkohen — lo tochal lo bitruma velo bemaaser.

a: Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael — lo tochal bitruma. met velah hemennu ben — lo tochal bitruma. nisset lelevi — tochal bemaaser. met velah hemennu ben — tochal bemaaser. nisset lechohen — tochal bitruma. met velah hemennu ben — tochal bitruma.
Met benah mikkohen — lo tochal bitruma. met benah millevi — lo tochal bemaaser. met benah miyyisrael — chozeret levet aviha, veal zo neemar: "veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel".
Gemara met benah millevi — tochal bitruma. dehadra achla mishshum benah, menalan? amar rabbi abba amar rav: "bat" "uvat".
Keman, kerabbi akiva dedaresh vave? afillu tema rabbanan, kulle "uvat" kera yattira hu.

Tanu rabbanan: keshehi chozeret — chozeret litruma, veenah chozeret lechaze vashok. amar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela: may kera — "hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel", bammuram min hakkodashim lo tochel. rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: "millechem", velo kol lechem, perat lechaze vashok.

Matkef la rame bar chama: ema: perat lahafarat nedarim! amar rava: kevar paska tanna deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "veneder almana ugerusha yakum aleha", ma talmud lomar? vahalo mutzaa mikkelal av, umutzaa mikkelal baal!

Ella, hare shemmasar haav lishluche habbaal, o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal, venitarmela o nitgarsha badderech, heach ani kore bah bet aviha shel zo, o bet balah shel zo, ella lomar lecha: kevan sheyyatza shaa achat mershut haav — shuv eno yachol lehafer.
Rav safra amar: "millechem aviha tochel", lechem velo basar. rav pappa amar: "millechem aviha tochel", lechem hakkanuy leaviha, perat lechaze vashok — demishshulchan gavoah ka zachu.
Verava amar: "veet chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu atta uvanecha uvenotecha ittach" — bizman sheittecha.
Amar rav adda bar ahava, tana: keshehi chozeret levet aviha — chozeret litruma, veenah chozeret lechaze vashok. bishvil benah — chozeret af lechaze vashok.
Azal rav mardochay, amra lishmata kammeh derav ashe. amar: mehecha ka mitrabbeya — miuvat", mi adifa la minna? hatam ketivi miute, hacha la ketivi miute.
Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "veshava el bet aviha" — perat leshomeret yavam. "kinureha" — perat limubberet.
Vahalo din hu: uma bimkom shello asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefotrah min hayyibbum — asa ubbar keyalud,
Makom sheasa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefoslah min hatteruma — eno din shennaase ubbar keyalud?!
La, ma li asa ubbar keyalud leinyan yibbum, shehare asa metim kechayyim — naase ubbar keyalud leinyan teruma, shello asa metim kechayyim?! talmud lomar: "kinureha" — perat limubberet.

Veitzterich lemichtav meubberet, veitzterich lemichtav "vezera en lah". dei ketav rachamana "vezera en lah", meikkara chad gufa vehasheta tere gufe, aval meubberet, demeikkara chad gufa vehasheta chad gufa — ema techol, tzericha. vei ketav rachamana meubberet, demeikkara gufa
b: Serika vehasheta gufa malya. aval "zera en lah", demeikkara gufa serika vehasheta gufa serika — ema la, tzericha.
[Siman: (amar leh) lo naase maaseha bemita naase velo naase bevalad yibbum uteruma yibbum uteruma — siman].

Amar leh rav yehuda middiskarta lerava: lo naase metim kechayyim leinyan yibbum mikkal vechomer: uma bemakom sheasa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefoslah min hatteruma — lo asa metim kechayyim; makom shello asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefotrah min hayyibbum — eno din shello naase metim kechayyim?!
Talmud lomar: "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom".

Venaasa metim kechayyim leinyan teruma mikkal vechomer: uma bemakom shello asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefotrah min hayyibbum — asa metim kechayyim; makom sheasa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni lefoslah min hatteruma — eno din shennaase metim kechayyim?! talmud lomar: "vezera en lah", veha en lah.

Venaase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni leinyan yibbum mikkal vechomer: uma bemakom shello asa metim kechayyim leinyan teruma — asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni; makom sheasa metim kechayyim leinyan yibbum — eno din shennaase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni?! talmud lomar: "uven en lo", veha en lo.

Velo naase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni litruma mikkal vechomer: ma bimkom sheasa metim kechayyim lefotrah min hayyibbum — lo asa valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni; makom shello asa metim kechayyim leinyan teruma — eno din shello naase valad min harishon kevalad min hashsheni?! talmud lomar: "en lah", veha yesh lah.
Hadaran alach yesh muttarot
Haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah "met balich", venisset, veachar kach ba balah — tetze mizze umizze, utzericha get mizze umizze,
Veen lah ketubba, velo perot, velo mezonot, velo belaot — lo al ze velo al ze. veim natla mizze umizze — tachzir.
Vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. velo ze vaze mittamme lah, velo ze vaze zakkaim lo bimtziatah, velo bemaase yadeha, velo bahafarat nedareha.

Hayta bat yisrael — nifsela min hakkehunna. uvat levi — min hammaaser, uvat kohen — min hatteruma. veen yorshin shel ze veyorshin shel ze yorshin et ketubbatah. veim metu — achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin velo meyaybmin.

Rabbi yose omer: ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon. rabbi elazar omer: harishon zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha. rabbi shimon omer: biatah o chalitzatah meachiv shel rishon poteret tzaratah. veen havvalad mimmennu mamzer.
Veim nissat shello birshut — mutteret lachzor lo. nisset al pi bet din — tetze, ufetura min hakkorban.
Lo nisset al pi bet din — tetze, vechayyevet bekorban. yippa koach bet din, sheppotrah min hakkorban. horuha bet din linnase, vehalcha vekilkela — chayyevet bekorban, shello hittiruha ella linnase.
Gemara middekatane sefa: nisset shello birshut — mutteret lachzor lo, shello birshut bet din, ella beedim. mikkelal deresha birshut bet din, uveed echad. alma ed echad neeman.
Utenan name: huchezku lihyot massiin ed mippi ed, veishsha mippi ishsha, veishsha mippi eved umippi shifcha. alma ed echad meheman.
Utenan name: ed echad omer "achalta chelev", vehu omer "lo achalti" — patur. tama deamar "lo achalti", ha ishtik — meheman. alma ed echad meheman middeorayyta.
Mena lan? detanya: "o hoda elav chattato". velo sheyyodiuhu acherim. yachol af al pi sheeno machchisho yehe patur? talmud lomar: "o hoda elav" — mikkol makom.

Hechi dame? illema daato tere vela ka machchish lehu, kera lema li? ella lav — chad, vechi la ka machchish leh — meheman, shema minna ed echad neeman. umimmay demishshum dimheman? dilma mishshum deka shatek, ushetika kehodaa damya?

Teda, dekatane sefa: amru shenayim "achalta chelev", vehu omer "lo achalti" — patur. rabbi meir mechayyev. amar rabbi meir: kal vachomer, im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura — lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal?
Amru lo: ma im yirtze lomar "mezid hayiti"! resha
